src: 重庆中职学校试点现代学徒制 入学即是企业准员工-新华网

chosen.text: Chongqing Secondary Vocational School Piloted Modern Apprenticeship System, Enrollment Is Enterprise Quasi-employee - Xinhuanet

src: 昨天，记者从市教委获悉，今年起，我市将在60所中职学校试点“现代学徒制”人才培养模式，接受试点培养的学生同时具备学徒身份，招生录入后将被试点企业预录为单位员工。

chosen.text: Yesterday, the reporter learned from the Municipal Education Commission that starting from this year, our city will pilot the "modern apprenticeship" talent training model in 60 secondary vocational schools. Students who are trained in the pilot will have the status of apprentices and will be pre-recorded as unit employees by the pilot enterprises after enrollment.

src: 市教委要求，规范中职学校招生录取和企业用工程序，明确学徒的中职学校学生和企业准员工双重身份，按照双向选择原则，学徒、学校和企业签订三方协议，对于年满16周岁未达到18周岁的学徒，须由学徒、监护人、学校和企业四方签订协议，确定各方权益及学徒在岗培养的具体岗位、教学内容、权益保障等。

chosen.text: The Municipal Education Commission requires that the enrollment and admission of secondary vocational schools and the employment procedures of enterprises should be standardized, the dual identities of apprentices as students in secondary vocational schools and quasi-employees of enterprises should be clarified, and the apprentices, schools and enterprises should sign a tripartite agreement according to the principle of two-way selection. For apprentices who are over 16 years old but under 18 years old, the apprentices, guardians, schools and enterprises should sign an agreement to determine the rights and interests of all parties and the specific positions, teaching content, rights and interests protection, etc. of apprentices on the job.

src: 鼓励试点学校采用现代学徒制形式与合作企业联合开展企业员工岗前培训和转岗培训。

chosen.text: Pilot schools are encouraged to adopt modern apprenticeship and cooperate with enterprises to carry out pre-job training and job transfer training for enterprise employees.

src: 试点学校要改革人才培养模式。

chosen.text: Pilot schools should reform the talent training model.

src: 校企共同设计人才培养方案，共同制订专业教学标准、课程标准、岗位标准、企业师傅标准、质量监控标准及相应实施方案。

chosen.text: Schools and enterprises jointly design talent training programs, and jointly formulate professional teaching standards, curriculum standards, post standards, enterprise master standards, quality control standards and corresponding implementation plans.

src: 试点以培养学制为一个试点周期，学生在企业的实习时间根据专业人才培养方案确定，顶岗实习一般为6个月。

chosen.text: The pilot is based on a one-year cycle, and the students' internship time in the enterprise is determined according to the professional talent training plan, with the internship generally lasting for six months.

src: 在企业实践应实施企业班组化管理模式，根据不同专业的特点，1个师傅可带2～5个徒弟，组成学习小组，确保学生熟练掌握每个轮训岗位所需的技能。

chosen.text: In enterprise practice, the enterprise team management model should be implemented. According to the characteristics of different majors, one master can take 2-5 apprentices to form a study group to ensure that students are proficient in the skills required for each rotation training post.

src: 根据安排，从2016年起到2019年8月，我市分三批确定60个市级中职现代学徒制试点，每个试点人数在50人左右，总共培养3000名左右学生（学徒 ） 。

chosen.text: According to the arrangement, from 2016 to August 2019, our city will determine 60 municipal pilot projects of modern apprenticeship in three batches, with about 50 people in each pilot project, and a total of about 3,000 students (apprentices) will be trained.

src: 按照先试点再推行，由点到面逐步推进的原则，探索建立校企联合招生、联合培养、一体化育人的长效机制，切实提升学生岗位技能，提高学生对口就业率和就业质量。

chosen.text: In accordance with the principle of first pilot and then implementation, and gradually promote from point to surface, we will explore and establish a long-term mechanism for joint enrollment, joint training, and integrated education between schools and enterprises, effectively improve students' post skills, and increase students' employment rate and employment quality.

src: 据美联社报道，随着奥密克戎变种在南非的传播，南非豪登省的一个五千多名医生组成医师组织报告说，他们目前治疗的新冠病人出现的症状都比较轻微，例如身体疼痛和咳嗽等与流感类似的症状。

chosen.text: According to the Associated Press, as the Omicron variant spreads in South Africa, a medical organization composed of more than 5,000 doctors in Gauteng Province reported that the symptoms of the COVID-19 patients they currently treat are relatively mild, such as body pain and cough, which are similar to flu symptoms.

src: 该组织总监安本·皮莱（Unben Pillay）医生说，他每天都要看几十名病人，但是还没有任何病人需要住院。

chosen.text: Dr Unben Pillay, the organisation's director, said he sees dozens of patients every day but none of them have been hospitalised.

src: 皮莱说 ： “ 他们能够在家里控制疾病，大多数人在隔离10至14天内康复 。 ”

chosen.text: Pillai said, "They can control the disease at home, and most people will recover within 10 to 14 days of isolation. "

src: 他说，这包括老年患者和那些有健康问题的患者，这些人群本来更容易因冠状病毒感染而陷入重症。

chosen.text: He said this includes elderly patients and those with underlying health conditions, who are more likely to become seriously ill from the coronavirus infection.

src: 他说，与之相比，在上一波的德尔塔疫情中，他治疗的新冠患者“呼吸困难，血氧水平低。

chosen.text: He said that in comparison, during the last wave of Delta infections, he treated COVID-19 patients who "were struggling to breathe and had low oxygen levels.

src: 许多人几天内就要住院 ” 。

chosen.text: Many people will be hospitalized in a few days."

src: 在南部非洲首次报告奥密克戎变异毒株后的两周内，其他医生也分享了类似的经验。

chosen.text: Similar experiences have been shared by other doctors within two weeks of the first report of the Omicron variant in southern Africa.

src: 虽然收集足够的数据还需要几个星期的时间，但医生的观察和早期证据提供了一些线索。

chosen.text: While it will take weeks to collect enough data, doctors' observations and early evidence are providing some clues.

src: 据南非国家传染病研究所总结：在近几周住院的新冠患者中，只有30%是严重病症，是前一波疫情重症比例的一半；平均住院时间从8天缩短到2.8天；近期的新冠患者中，仅有3%死亡，而在南非早期爆发的病例中，死亡比例达20 % 。

chosen.text: According to the National Institute for Communicable Diseases of South Africa, among the COVID-19 patients hospitalized in recent weeks, only 30% were severe cases, which is half of the proportion of severe cases in the previous wave; the average length of hospital stay was shortened from 8 days to 2.8 days; among the recent COVID-19 patients, only 3% died, while the death rate in the early outbreak in South Africa reached 20%.

src: 非洲健康研究所所长威廉·哈内科姆（Willem Hanekom）引用国家传染病研究所的数据和其他报告说 ： “ 目前，几乎所有的迹象都表明，这是一种较温和的疾病 。 ”

chosen.text: According to data from the National Institute for Infectious Diseases and other reports, Willem Hanekom, director of the African Health Research Institute, said, "At present, almost all signs indicate that this is a mild disease. "

src: 他还说 ： “ 现在还是早期，我们需要获得后期数据。

chosen.text: He also said, "It is still early and we need to get later data.

src: 通常情况下，住院和死亡发生的时间较晚，而我们进入这一波疫情的时间只有两周 。 ”

chosen.text: Usually, hospitalization and death occur later, and we have been in this wave of the epidemic for only two weeks. "

src: 与此同时，世界各地的科学家正在观察病例数和住院率，同时测试目前的疫苗和治疗方法的效果。

chosen.text: Meanwhile, scientists around the world are observing case numbers and hospitalization rates while testing the effectiveness of current vaccines and treatment methods.

src: 尽管德尔塔仍然是全世界主要的新冠病毒株，但奥密克戎病例正在数十个国家出现，其中南非为疫情中心。

chosen.text: Although Delta remains the dominant strain of the virus worldwide, Omicron cases are emerging in dozens of countries, with South Africa at the epicenter of the outbreak.

src: 如果类比“没有买卖就没有杀害”的著名公益广告语，那么，在没有“收拐”需求的良好环境里，群防群治、全民反拐，使拐卖行为无利可图、风险大、成本高，这类犯罪也就不会屡屡发生。

chosen.text: If we make an analogy with the famous public service advertisement "No buying, no killing", then in a good environment without the demand for "kidnapping", the crime of kidnapping would not occur frequently if people work together to prevent and control it, and the whole nation fights against it, making the act of kidnapping unprofitable, risky and costly.

chosen.text: This is an Internet information platform created to establish an authoritative channel for releasing information on missing children and to find abducted children in time.

src: 听闻此App名为“团圆 ” ， 顿觉暖意十足。

chosen.text: Hearing that this App is named “Reunion”, I felt warm.

src: 新技术手段不仅名称“文艺 ” 、 情怀满满，而且信息化运用得当，实用、有效。

chosen.text: The new technology is not only named “literary and artistic” and full of sentiment, but also properly applied in information technology, practical and effective.

src: 打拐执法，首要目标是寻回被拐的孩子，保护其人身安全、自由。

chosen.text: The primary goal of anti-abduction law enforcement is to find abducted children and protect their personal safety and freedom.

src: 其次才是对嫌疑人的审判与惩罚。

chosen.text: Second, there is the trial and punishment of suspects.

src: 刑事惩罚的意义，从个别惩罚、社会预防到法律教育，可以列举很多“大词 ” 。

chosen.text: The significance of criminal punishment, from individual punishment, social prevention to legal education, can list many "big words".

src: 但在拐卖案件告破之前，应优先关注被害人的人身安全。

chosen.text: However, before the trafficking case is solved, priority should be given to the personal safety of the victims.

src: 事分轻重缓急，在急切的“寻救”目的之下，诸如“拐卖儿童是否应当一律死刑”之类众说纷纭、争议较大的话题，可以暂搁下来，谨慎讨论；但救助被拐儿童的事情等不得。

chosen.text: We should prioritize and put aside controversial topics such as "whether child trafficking should be punishable by death" for careful discussion under the urgent purpose of "searching for help", but we cannot wait to rescue abducted children.

src: 根据此类案件的侦办经验，人贩子惯于在得手之后尽快远离作案地点。

chosen.text: Based on the experience of handling such cases, human traffickers are used to leaving the crime scene as soon as possible after they succeed.

src: 寻拐行动多耽搁一分钟，孩子就可能更远离家长一步，案件侦破的难度也就增加一分。

chosen.text: Every minute of delay in the abduction operation may make the child further away from his parents, and the difficulty of solving the case will increase.

src: 在此情况下，拿出如“团圆”平台这样直接有助于侦破案件、寻回孩子的有效办法，确实是务实的行动。

chosen.text: In this case, it is a pragmatic action to come up with an effective method such as the “Reunion” platform that can directly help solve cases and find children.

src: 毕竟 ， “ 打拐”是需要运作起整个法制系统来做好的一件大任务。

chosen.text: After all, "fighting against abduction" is a major task that requires the operation of the entire legal system.

src: 打击犯罪、保障儿童和家长权益，从立法的完善，到司法的保障，以及执法的缜密，无不需要贯彻“护幼扶弱”的关怀。

chosen.text: To combat crime and protect children and parents, from the improvement of legislation to judicial protection and the meticulousness of law enforcement, we need to implement the care of "protecting young people and supporting the weak".

src: 此外，拐卖儿童的预防，从家庭到社会，都还可以做得更好。

chosen.text: In addition, prevention of child trafficking can be improved from family to society.

src: 比如一个常见的案例，一家三口在火车站休息，父母熟睡，醒来才发现孩子不见了。

chosen.text: For example, a common case is that a family of three rests at the railway station. The parents are fast asleep and wake up to find that their child has disappeared.

src: 不能期待一个两岁的孩子具有足够的自我保护技能，但作为年幼孩子的家长，应至少具有相当的保护意识。

chosen.text: A two-year-old cannot be expected to have enough self-protection skills, but as a parent of a young child, you should at least have considerable awareness.

src: 父母两人轮流休息，又或将孩子置于稳妥的保护之下，都是预防儿童被拐的最起码手段。

chosen.text: Parents should take turns to rest or put children in safe protection, which is the minimum means of preventing children from being kidnapped.

src: 从警方打击拐卖犯罪的另一面看，购买被拐儿童一方也应被关注和惩治。

chosen.text: From another aspect of the police's fight against trafficking crimes, the side that purchases abducted children should also be concerned and punished.

src: 单个的不法行为，往往只是长长链条中的一环。

chosen.text: A single act of wrongdoing is often just one link in a long chain.

src: 根据我国《刑法》规定，拐卖儿童罪的法定刑起刑点为5年；情节特别严重的，可至死刑，并处没收财产。

chosen.text: According to China's Criminal Law, the legal penalty for the crime of child trafficking is 5 years; in cases of especially serious circumstances, the penalty may be death and confiscation of property.

src: 起刑点高、最高刑重，在“轻刑化”的大趋势下，拐卖儿童罪显然属于处罚较重的罪。

chosen.text: The starting point of the penalty is high and the maximum penalty is heavy. Under the general trend of "light punishment", the crime of kidnapping and selling children obviously belongs to a crime with heavy punishment.

src: 可至今每年仍还有不少的拐卖案件发生。

chosen.text: However, there are still many cases of trafficking every year.

src: 可见，部分人在养育儿女方面的观念落后，法律意识淡薄。

chosen.text: It can be seen that some people have backward concepts in raising children and weak legal awareness.

src: 对这部分人的法制教育应该同步跟进。

chosen.text: The legal education of this part of people should be followed up in parallel.

src: 要有效控制拐卖犯罪，不能仅靠官方严格执法。

chosen.text: To effectively control the crime of trafficking, we cannot rely solely on strict law enforcement by the authorities.

src: 倘若收拐“市场”广泛存在，拐卖者利欲熏心，不断创新拐卖手段，形成与执法者的“斗法”局面，打拐行动势必会陷入低效的泥淖。

chosen.text: If the "market" of abduction is widespread, and the abductors are greedy for money, they will constantly innovate their methods of abduction, forming a "battle" with law enforcement officers, and the anti-abduction campaign will inevitably fall into an inefficient quagmire.

src: 因此，破除落后观念，普及法律常识，也有助于根治拐卖、收买儿童犯罪。

chosen.text: Therefore, breaking away from backward ideas and popularizing legal knowledge will also help to eradicate the crime of child trafficking and buying.

src: 他指出，要将全会精神和习近平总书记对湖南重要讲话重要指示批示精神、省党代会精神结合起来学，融会贯通学，增强捍卫“两个确立 ” 、 做到“两个维护”的思想自觉、政治自觉、行动自觉，坚定不移沿着习近平总书记指引的方向前进。

chosen.text: He pointed out that we should combine the spirit of the plenary session with the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speeches, instructions and directives to Hunan, and the spirit of the Provincial Party Congress, and study them thoroughly, enhance the ideological, political and action consciousness of defending the "two establishments" and achieving the "two upholds", and move forward along the direction guided by General Secretary Xi Jinping.

src: 在互动交流环节，基层干部代表、企业代表、青年代表就三个历史决议的关系、如何理解“两个确立”的决定性意义、文化企业如何把握导向、新时代青年如何从百年党史中汲取力量等进行了提问，杨浩东以通俗的语言、生动的事例一一解答，他殷殷寄语青年党员，要从党的百年奋斗史中，汲取奋进的力量，紧密团结在党中央周围，坚定不移跟党走,用青春奉献书写责任和担当。

chosen.text: During the interactive session, representatives of grass-roots cadres, enterprises and young people asked questions about the relationship between the three historical resolutions, how to understand the decisive significance of "two establishments", how cultural enterprises should grasp the orientation, and how young people in the new era should draw strength from the century-long history of the Party. src: 新华社北京12月11日电（记者阳娜）记者从近日北京市教委、北京市人力资源和社会保障局联合召开的2022届北京高校毕业生就业创业工作视频会议上获悉，2022年北京地区高校毕业生预计达26.8万人，比去年增加1.6万人。

chosen.text: Xinhua News Agency, Beijing, December 11 (Reporter Yang Na) The reporter learned from the 2022 Beijing University Graduates Employment and Entrepreneurship Video Conference jointly held by the Beijing Municipal Education Commission and the Beijing Human Resources and Social Security Bureau that the number of university graduates in Beijing is expected to reach 268,000 in 2022, an increase of 16,000 over last year.

src: 北京市人力资源和社会保障局相关负责人表示，将从加强供需匹配、强化政策支持、拓宽就业渠道、确保困难帮扶、支持创新创业、提升服务效能等方面部署北京高校毕业生就业工作。

chosen.text: According to the relevant person in charge of Beijing Human Resources and Social Security Bureau, Beijing will deploy the employment work for college graduates from aspects such as strengthening supply and demand matching, strengthening policy support, broadening employment channels, ensuring assistance to the needy, supporting innovation and entrepreneurship, and improving service efficiency.

src: 记者了解到，北京市人力资源和社会保障局将搭建实践平台，加大岗位供给，主动联系40家高校毕业生职场体验基地，走访用人单位，整合需求信息和岗位信息；重点抓好“六个一批 ” ， 即拓宽事业单位招录一批，拓宽国有企业招聘一批，拓宽基层项目招募一批，拓宽应征入伍一批，拓宽就业见习留用一批，拓宽创业带动就业一批；实行“一生一策”动态管理，为每位毕业生推荐不少于5个岗位信息，确保有就业意愿的困难家庭毕业生100%实现帮扶等。

chosen.text: The reporter learned that the Beijing Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau will build a practice platform, increase job supply, take the initiative to contact 40 workplace experience bases for college graduates, visit employers, and integrate demand information and job information; focus on "six batches", namely, expand the recruitment of public institutions, expand the recruitment of state-owned enterprises, expand the recruitment of grass-roots projects, expand the recruitment of conscripts, expand the employment probation and retention, and expand the entrepreneurship-driven employment; implement "one policy for one life" dynamic management, recommend no less than 5 job information for each graduate, and ensure that 100% of the graduates from poor families who are willing to work will be helped.

src: 精炼橄榄油是指酸度超过3.3%的初榨橄榄油精炼后所得到的橄榄油，或成为“二次油”。

chosen.text: Refined olive oil is olive oil that has been refined from virgin olive oil with an acidity level greater than 3.3% or becomes "second oil".

chosen.text: Olive Oil: Refined olive oil mixed with a certain proportion of extra virgin olive oil to blend the taste and color, with acidity below 1.5%, is transparent light golden yellow.

src: 精炼橄榄杂质油或橄榄果渣油（Refined Olive-Pomace Oil）：是通过溶解法从油渣中提取并经过精炼而得到的橄榄油。

src: 民主峰会落幕，拜登称自由之火永不熄灭

chosen.text: After the conclusion of the Summit, Biden said that the fire of freedom will never go out

src: 由美国总统拜登召集、有全球110个国家的政府以及公民社会和私营部门领导人出席的线上“民主峰会 ” ( Summit for Democracy)星期五（12月10日）落幕。

chosen.text: The online "Summit for Democracy" convened by U.S. President Biden, attended by government leaders, civil society and private sector leaders from 110 countries around the world, ended on Friday (December 10).

src: 拜登在闭幕词中说，自由之火在世界每个人的心中燃烧，专制政权永远无法将其熄灭。

chosen.text: The torch of freedom burns in everyone's heart around the world, and authoritarian regimes can never extinguish it, Biden said in his closing remarks.

src: 他也表示，计划明年召开第二届全球“民主峰会 ” 。

chosen.text: He also said that he plans to hold a second global "democracy summit" next year.

src: 台湾政府代表、政务委员唐凤和目前流亡英国的香港民主人权活动人士罗冠聪也在第二天的峰会上发言。

chosen.text: Tang Fenghe, a representative of the Taiwan government and a member of the Executive Yuan, and Luo Guansheng, a Hong Kong pro-democracy and human rights activist currently in exile in the UK, also spoke at the summit on the second day.

src: 拜登说 ： “ 我们知道摆在我们面前的工作是多么的艰巨。

chosen.text: Biden said, "We know how difficult the work ahead of us is.

src: 但我们也知道，我们可以迎接挑战，因为我以前说过，正如这次峰会所表明的，民主世界无处不在。

chosen.text: But we also know that we can meet the challenge, because as I have said before, and as this summit has shown, the democratic world is everywhere.

src: 专制政权永远无法熄灭自由的微火，它在全世界和世界各地人们的心中燃烧 。 ”

chosen.text: The dictatorship can never extinguish the small fire of freedom, which burns in the world and in the hearts of people all over the world. "

src: 拜登还表示，捍卫民主需要整个社会的共同努力。

chosen.text: Biden also said that defending democracy requires the joint efforts of the whole society.

src: 他说 ： “ 作为政府的领导人，我们有责任倾听我们的公民，加固民主的护栏，推动改革，实现透明的问责治理，更能抵御专制的缓冲和冲击的力量，以及那些想在公共利益之前赤裸裸地追求权力的人 。 ”

chosen.text: He said, "As leaders of the government, we have a responsibility to listen to our citizens, strengthen the guardrails of democracy, promote reform, achieve transparent accountability governance, and be more resistant to the buffer and impact of autocracy, as well as those who want to pursue power nakedly before the public interest. "

src: “民主峰会”第二天的主题分别是捍卫人权，巩固民主与对抗威权，以及反击数字威权主义与肯定民主价值。

chosen.text: The themes of the second day of the "Democracy Summit" are defending human rights, consolidating democracy and confronting authoritarianism, as well as countering digital authoritarianism and affirming democratic values.

src: 这一天恰逢“国际人权日 ” 。

chosen.text: This day coincides with "International Human Rights Day".

src: 联合国秘书长古特雷斯在当天的开场讲话中也表示，民主事业在全球面临挑战，特别是新兴数字技术带来的挑战。

chosen.text: In his opening speech on the same day, UN Secretary-General Guterres also said that the cause of democracy is facing challenges globally, especially those brought about by emerging digital technologies.

src: 他说 ： “ 现在是重申共同价值观和立场以及民主韧性的时候了。

chosen.text: He said, "It is time to reaffirm common values and positions as well as democratic resilience.

src: 这需要深化社会对话，解决不平等问题，打击腐败，更新社会契约，为优质教育投资，并扩大妇女和女童的机会。

chosen.text: This requires deepening social dialogue, addressing inequality, fighting corruption, renewing the social contract, investing in quality education and expanding opportunities for women and girls.

src: 这也需要坚决谴责一切形式的民粹主义、本土主义和极端主义，包括利用技术革命所提供的所有工具 。 ”

chosen.text: This also requires a firm condemnation of all forms of populism, localism and extremism, including using all tools provided by the technological revolution. "

src: 香港民主人权活动人士罗冠聪通过预先录制的视频对峰会发表讲话，提醒与会者持续关注香港和维吾尔族和藏族等中国少数民族的人权状况。

chosen.text: Hong Kong pro-democracy and human rights activist Luo Guansheng addressed the summit through a pre-recorded video, reminding participants to continue to pay attention to the human rights situation in Hong Kong and ethnic minorities in China such as Uyghurs and Tibetans.

src: 他说 ： “ 长期以来，世界一直接受中国的崛起，却没有建立一个机制来对其进行问责。

chosen.text: He said, "For a long time, the world has accepted China's rise, but there is no mechanism to hold it accountable.

chosen.text: This is why politicians and civil society leaders must work together.

chosen.text: We must use everything we have (resources) to ensure that the revival of democracy is our top priority. "

chosen.text: He said, "Maybe some of you are afraid to upset General Secretary Xi Jinping, maybe some of you don't want to lose the Chinese market, maybe some of you don't realize the threat (of the CCP) to our democratic values.

src: 而这就是我们失败的原因。

chosen.text: And that's why we failed.

src: 这也是我们必须改变的原因 。 ”

chosen.text: This is also why we must change. "

src: 台湾行政院政务委员唐凤在出席“打击数字独裁主义，肯定民主价值”的圆桌讨论中，通过视频发布《国家声明 》 ， 强调台湾站在对抗专制和威权的最前线。

chosen.text: Tang Feng, a member of the Executive Yuan of Taiwan, issued a National Declaration via video during the round-table discussion on "fighting digital authoritarianism and affirming democratic values", emphasizing that Taiwan is at the forefront of the fight against autocracy and authoritarianism.

src: 他也分享了如何通过信息透明与构建互信来抗击新冠疫情的经验。

chosen.text: He also shared his experience of combating the novel coronavirus pneumonia through information transparency and building mutual trust.

src: 他说 ： “ 在台湾的民主方兴未艾之际，我们始终坚定站在全球对抗威权主义的最前线，更在促进全球自由、民主和人权上，扮演领导角色。

chosen.text: He said, "As democracy in Taiwan is on the rise, we have always firmly stood at the forefront of global confrontation against authoritarianism and played a leading role in promoting global freedom, democracy, and human rights.

src: 于疫情期间，各地的威权政府以公共卫生和集体利益为名，合理化侵犯人权的行为，全球民主呈现倒退的迹象。

chosen.text: During the pandemic, authoritarian governments around the world have rationalized human rights violations in the name of public health and collective interest, and there are signs that global democracy has regressed.

src: 然而在台湾，我们不必封城就能控制疫情，不必下架就能战胜假信息 。 ”

chosen.text: However, in Taiwan, we can control the epidemic without lockdowns and defeat fake information without taking them off shelves. "

chosen.text: Jiangxi will train 10,000 rural primary school music, physical education and art teachers within three years - Xinhuanet

src: 新华社南昌５月２２日电（记者陈毓珊）记者近日从江西省教育厅获悉，为增强紧缺学科教师队伍保障能力，实现乡村义务教育均衡发展，自２０１６年起，江西省规划用３年时间为全省乡村（乡镇及以下）每所小学培训合格的音乐、美术、体育教师各１名，共计１万名。

chosen.text: Xinhua News Agency, Nanchang, May 22 (Reporter Chen Yushan) The reporter learned from the Jiangxi Provincial Department of Education that in order to enhance the guarantee ability of the shortage of teachers and achieve balanced development of rural compulsory education, since 2016, Jiangxi Province plans to train 1 qualified music teacher, 1 qualified art teacher and 1 qualified physical education teacher for each primary school in rural areas (townships and below) in the province within three years, totaling 10,000.

src: 据了解，这次培训对象为江西全省乡村小学４５岁以下具有音乐、美术、体育学科知识基础或才能，能兼任音乐、美术、体育课程的其他学科教师。

chosen.text: It is understood that the training targets are rural primary school teachers in Jiangxi Province under 45 years old who have a knowledge base or talent in music, art and physical education, and can also teach other subjects.

src: 通过培训，使他们掌握音体美学科教学的基本知识和教学技能，更新教学思想和观念，掌握现代教学方法，提高学科教学能力、活动设计能力、校园文化能力及自我发展能力，建设一支一专多能的音体美教师队伍，缓解乡村音体美教师缺乏的问题。

chosen.text: Through training, they will master the basic knowledge and teaching skills of music, physical education and art subject teaching, update teaching ideas and concepts, master modern teaching methods, improve subject teaching ability, activity design ability, campus culture ability and self-development ability, build a team of music, physical education and art teachers with one speciality and multiple abilities, and ease the problem of lack of rural music, physical education and art teachers.

src: 为确保培训质量和效果，江西还规划为全省１００个县（市、区）小学音乐、美术、体育各培训１名，共计３００名培训者，全面提升他们的教学示范引领能力、教研活动设计组织能力、施训能力、网络研修工作坊建设能力，起到教授、示范、指导、监督的作用。

chosen.text: To ensure the quality and effectiveness of training, Jiangxi also plans to train 100 primary school music, art, and sports teachers in 100 counties (cities, districts) across the province, totaling 300 trainers, to comprehensively improve their teaching demonstration leadership, teaching research activity design and organization, training, and online workshop construction capabilities, and play a role in teaching, demonstration, guidance, and supervision.

src: 前段时间有篇《快看！项目经理可冲击金牌的奥运项目》文章很火，里面提到项目经理们在很多项目上，绝对是可以一马当先，无人能匹： 搬砖、出差、熬夜是项目经理的日常，救火、背锅、道歉更是不在话下。

chosen.text: A while ago, an article titled “Look! The Olympic event that project managers can compete for gold” was very popular. It mentioned that project managers are definitely able to take the lead in many projects: moving bricks, business trips, staying up late are the daily routine of project managers, and putting out fires, taking the blame, and apologizing are not a problem.

src: 看似玩笑调侃的一篇文章，却也道出了项目经理们的日常辛酸，背后代表的是对当前项目管理工作的力不从心。

chosen.text: An article that seems like a joke, but it also reveals the daily hardships of project managers, and behind it is the powerlessness of current project management work.

src: 而从事项目管理工作的人员，也渐渐选择通过一些行动来让自己摆脱工作中的困境。

chosen.text: And those who are engaged in project management also gradually choose to take some actions to get out of the predicament in their work.

src: 从每年攀升的PMP（国际认证的项目管理专业人士资格）报名人数来看，越来越多的项目管理从业人员通过学习来提升自己的项目管理能力。

chosen.text: From the annual climbing PMP (International Certification of Project Management Professional Qualification) registration numbers, more and more project management practitioners are learning to improve their project management capabilities.

src: 据《中国项目管理二十年发展报告(1999-2019)》称：截止到2019年9月，全国累计PMP®报考人数近60万人次，通过PMP®认证人数约42万人，有效持证人数约30万人, 占全球PMP®持证总量的31.2%。

chosen.text: According to the “Report on the Development of China’s Project Management in the Past 20 Years (1999-2019)”, as of September 2019, the cumulative number of PMP® applicants nationwide was nearly 600,000, the number of PMP® certified persons was about 420,000, and the number of valid certificate holders was about 300,000, accounting for 31.2% of the total number of PMP® certificates globally.

src: 近10年PMP持证人数逐年递增，这说明越来越多的项目管理者意识到：靠简单照搬以往“老经验”来做事已不可取，瞬息万变的工作环境让我们知道一个要学会，站在科学巨人的肩膀上去探索前行的道路。

chosen.text: In the past 10 years, the number of PMP certified persons has increased year by year, which shows that more and more project managers have realized that it is not advisable to rely on simple copying of previous "old experience" to do things. The ever-changing working environment tells us that we should learn from the giants of science and explore the way forward.

src: 然而，考了PMP就能保证项目管理工作畅通无阻了吗？

chosen.text: However, does obtaining a PMP certification guarantee smooth project management?

src: 很多项目管理初学者表示，通过学习PMP/IPMP等相关课程，可以系统性地掌握项目管理的十大领域和五大过程组等相关知识点，但真正进行项目管理工作的时候却还是一头雾水。

chosen.text: Many beginners in project management say that by studying PMP/IPMP and other related courses, they can systematically master the ten areas of project management and five process groups and other related knowledge points, but when they actually carry out project management work, they are still confused.

src: 很多项目经理常常反馈以下问题： 项目管理认知不到位，单纯依靠个人经验，空有项目管理理论，不知如何实践； 缺乏系统的项目管理流程制度支撑，工作中无法落地，项目预估不准，把控度灵敏度差，项目一拖再拖； 成员分工不明确、团队中的“老油条”不知如何应对 跨部门协助沟通不顺畅，项目难以推进 ……

chosen.text: Many project managers often report the following problems: lack of awareness of project management, relying solely on personal experience, having only project management theory but not knowing how to practice; lack of systematic project management process and system support, unable to implement in work, inaccurate project estimation, poor control sensitivity, and project delays; unclear division of labor among members, and the "veterans" in the team do not know how to respond; cross-departmental assistance and communication are not smooth, and it is difficult to advance the project...

src: 因此，专注产品创新与研发管理领域十余载，已帮助众多优秀的企业培养了大批的产品经理、项目经理等研发关键人才，并获得了 “中国企业研发管理人才培训示范基地”等荣誉称号的中天华夏咨询带着《研发项目经理特训营》线上课程来了。

chosen.text: Therefore, Zhongtian Huaxia Consulting, which has focused on product innovation and R&D management for more than a decade, has helped many excellent enterprises to train a large number of key R&D talents such as product managers and project managers, and has won honorary titles such as "China Enterprise R&D Management Talent Training Demonstration Base". It has brought the online course "R&D Project Manager Special Training Camp".

src: 《研发项目经理特训营》线上课程 这是一种线上碎片化学习的方式，结合了众多研发型企业的实战案例、工具和方法，帮助您掌握项目经理必备知识及标准动作，走上自身项目管理的进阶之路。

chosen.text: Online course of "R&D Project Management Training Camp" is a way of online fragmented learning, which combines many actual cases, tools and methods of R&D enterprises to help you master the necessary knowledge and standard actions of project managers and take the path of advanced project management.

src: 这也是一次让企业用更低的成本和更少的投入，促进项目经理的培养进程，为企业带来高效运作结果的机会。

chosen.text: This is also an opportunity to promote the training process of project managers with lower costs and less investment, and bring high-efficiency operation results for enterprises.

src: 口说无凭，可以先看看其他学员怎么评价这门课程： 这门课程不仅是由中天华夏专家团队（原华为研发管理团队），结合国际先进的项目管理方法论和众多知名企业真实业务场景，对课程内容进行深入浅出的专业讲解。

chosen.text: Without evidence, you can first see how other students evaluate this course: This course is not only taught by Zhongtian Huaxia expert team (former Huawei R&D management team), combined with international advanced project management methodology and many well-known enterprises real business scenarios, to give a professional explanation of the course content in simple terms.

src: 更是会提供科学实用的管理工具与方法，丰富的模板表单，帮助学员在课后将学习的内容转化运用于具体工作。

src: 在“双十二”到来前夕，捷信消费金融有限公司（以下简称“捷信 ” ） 发出理性消费倡导，提醒广大用户尤其是年轻人树立良好的消费意识与消费习惯，拒绝盲目消费与过度消费。

chosen.text: On the eve of the “Singles’ Day”, China Finance Consumer Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as “CFCC”) issued a rational consumption advocacy, reminding users, especially young people, to establish good consumption awareness and habits, and reject blind and excessive consumption.

src: 据人民银行今年发布的《消费者金融素养调查分析报告》结果显示，全国消费者金融素养指数为66.81，与2019年相比，提高2.04。

chosen.text: According to the results of the "Consumer Financial Literacy Survey and Analysis Report" released by the People's Bank of China this year, the national consumer financial literacy index is 66.81, which is 2.04 higher than that in 2019.

src: 总体上，我国居民在金融消费层面上的表现较好，但在金融行为和技能的不同方面体现出较大的差异性，还需要进一步提升基础金融知识水平。

chosen.text: Overall, China’s residents have performed well in terms of financial consumption, but there are significant differences in different aspects of financial behavior and skills, so it is necessary to further improve the level of basic financial knowledge.

src: 老年人和青少年的金融素养水平相对较低 ， “ 一老一少”仍将是金融教育持续关注的重点对象；尼尔森发布的《中国年轻人负债状况报告》及央视财经发布的《2019-2020中国青年消费报告》显示，年轻一代具有巨大的消费潜力，信用消费成为消费升级重要途径，86.6%的年轻人都在使用信贷产品，近半数人没有债务累积，年轻一代虽然整体呈现理性消费趋势，虽与外界贴上的“过度挥霍”标签大相径庭，但部分年轻人的确存在过度消费、跟风消费行为，并因此产生了过大的财务压力和债务风险，甚至导致社会问题逐渐增加，金融企业应勇于承担社会责任，进行正向引导。

chosen.text: The financial literacy of the elderly and young people is relatively low, and "the elderly and young" will still be the key objects of continuous attention in financial education; the "Report on the Debt Situation of Chinese Youth" released by Nielsen and the "2019-2020 China Youth Consumption Report" released by CCTV Finance show that the younger generation has great consumption potential, credit consumption has become an important way to upgrade consumption, 86.6% of young people are using credit products, nearly half of them have no debt accumulation, although the younger generation shows a rational consumption trend overall, which is very different from the "excessive spending" label attached by the outside world, but some young people do have excessive consumption and follow-up consumption behavior, and thus have too much financial pressure and debt risk, and even lead to gradual increase in social problems, financial enterprises should be brave in taking social responsibility and positive guidance.

src: 作为持牌消费金融机构，捷信一直致力于以优质、贴心的服务助力百姓构建自己的幸福生活，倡导消费者树立良好正确的消费观，并积极响应监管号召，以实际行动提升消费者尤其是年轻群体的理性消费意识。

chosen.text: As a licensed consumer finance institution, Home Credit has been committed to helping people build their own happy life with high-quality and considerate services, advocating that consumers establish good and correct consumption concepts, and actively responding to regulatory calls to enhance the rational consumption awareness of consumers, especially young people, with practical actions.

src: 在过去多年间，捷信不断针对包含大学生在内的青年群体开展全方位、多样化的金融知识普及活动，并通过与国内顶级院校合作发动创新实践大赛等多种形式潜移默化对年轻群体的消费需求进行合理引导,帮助其树立理性消费观念,合理规划消费需求,进而为其累积人生财富助力。

chosen.text: Over the past few years, China Credit Suisse has continuously carried out all-round and diverse financial knowledge popularization activities for young people including college students, and through cooperation with top domestic universities, it has launched various forms of innovation practice competitions to subtly guide the consumption needs of young people, help them establish rational consumption concepts, plan their consumption needs, and then help them accumulate wealth in life.

src: 双十二到来之际，捷信提醒所有消费者朋友树立合理的消费意识和正确的金钱观，抵制盲目消费和过度消费，规避消费借贷误区，以免影响个人征信以及今后的经济生活。

chosen.text: As Singles’ Day approaches, GIVI reminds all consumers to establish a reasonable consumption awareness and correct view of money, resist blind and excessive consumption, and avoid misunderstandings about consumer loans, so as not to affect personal credit and future economic life.

src: 消费时一定要提前规划，量力而为按时还款。

chosen.text: You must plan in advance when consuming, and repay on time according to your ability.

src: 如果逾期，逾期记录将记录到个人信用报告中，可能会对日后买车、购房等经济生活造成不良影响。

chosen.text: If overdue, the overdue record will be recorded in the personal credit report, which may have a negative impact on future economic life such as buying cars and houses.

src: 与此同时，在享受金融产品和服务时，还应选择正规机构及渠道，并注意查验相关机构是否具备经营资质。

chosen.text: At the same time, when enjoying financial products and services, you should also choose formal institutions and channels, and pay attention to checking whether relevant institutions have business qualifications.

src: 未来，捷信将一如既往凭借其成熟、可靠的消费金融体系和不断更新迭代的金融产品，为消费者带来更贴合需求和多元化的服务，不断助力大众提升金融知识水平，帮助消费者培养理性消费、适度借贷的理念，做消费者终生可信赖的消费金融伙伴。

chosen.text: In the future, as always, China Finance will rely on its mature and reliable consumer finance system and constantly updated financial products to bring more diversified services that meet the needs of consumers, continuously help the public improve their financial knowledge, help consumers cultivate the concept of rational consumption and appropriate borrowing, and become a consumer finance partner that consumers can trust for life.

src: 让大学精神与时代精神同频共振-新华网

chosen.text: Let the university spirit resonate with the spirit of the times - Xinhuanet

src: 所谓大学精神，是指一所大学在发展过程中长期积淀形成的一系列办学理念和价值追求，是大学的灵魂所在。

chosen.text: The so-called university spirit refers to a series of school-running concepts and value pursuits formed by a long-term accumulation in the development process of a university, which is the soul of the university.

src: 从古至今，大学精神对于政治、经济、文化、科技、社会的发展，乃至一个民族的进步均至关重要。

chosen.text: From ancient times to the present, the university spirit is crucial for the development of politics, economy, culture, science and technology, society, and even the progress of a nation.

src: 从世界第一所现代意义上的大学诞生起，大学就肩负起不同于其他社会组织的独特使命，对于我国大学来说，兴起于民族危难之秋，其精神更是深受传统文化和时代变迁的影响，倡导“明德济世，修齐治平”的价值理念和“兴学强国”的爱国主义担当。

chosen.text: Since the birth of the world's first modern university, universities have taken on a unique mission different from other social organizations. For our country's universities, which emerged in the autumn of national crisis, their spirit is deeply influenced by traditional culture and changes in the times, advocating the value concept of "moral integrity and helping the world, self-cultivation, family management, state governance, and peace" and the patriotic responsibility of "revitalizing education and strengthening the nation".

src: 当前，高等教育信息化、国际化趋势日益明显，全球范围的教育竞争、科技竞争、人才竞争不断加剧，高等教育事业作为重要的“供给侧 ” ， 其结构性改革正面临前所未有的机遇和挑战。

chosen.text: At present, the trend of informatization and internationalization in higher education is becoming increasingly obvious, and the global competition in education, science and technology, and talent is intensifying. As an important “supply side”, the structural reform of higher education is facing unprecedented opportunities and challenges.

src: 尤其是《统筹推进世界一流大学和一流学科建设总体方案》的提出，在展示了我国从高等教育大国向高等教育强国迈进的信心和决心的同时，更是对大学发展提出了更高更新的要求。

chosen.text: In particular, the proposal of the Overall Plan for Coordinating the Construction of World-class Universities and First-class Disciplines has demonstrated China's confidence and determination to move from a large country with higher education to a powerful country with higher education, and has also put forward higher and newer requirements for the development of universities.

src: 如何在较短时间内努力跻身世界一流行列，在仍有一定差距的基础上加快建成若干所世界一流大学和一批世界一流学科，实现“弯道超车 ” ？

chosen.text: How can we strive to rank among the world’s top universities in a relatively short time, accelerate the construction of several world-class universities and a number of world-class disciplines on the basis of still having certain gaps, and achieve “overtaking on a curve”?

src: 除了坚定目标自信、路径自信、能力自信，高校还应当充分发挥三种优势：一是后发优势，通过持续引进海外杰出学术人才，学习借鉴世界一流大学的先进经验，实现学术水平和办学质量的显著提升；二是文化优势，继承中华文明在五千年积淀的智慧内涵，弘扬发展优秀传统文化，以此来凝聚力量、塑造品牌、提升形象；三是制度优势，发挥社会主义国家的制度优越性，强化目标驱动，汇集共识合力，优化资源配置，为学校加速赶超世界先进水平提供可持续的坚实保障。

chosen.text: In addition to firm confidence in goals, paths and capabilities, universities should also give full play to three advantages: first, latecomer advantage, by continuously introducing outstanding overseas academic talents, learning from the advanced experience of world-class universities, and achieving a significant improvement in academic level and school-running quality; second, cultural advantage, inheriting the wisdom of Chinese civilization accumulated over five thousand years, carrying forward and developing excellent traditional culture, so as to gather strength, shape brands and enhance image; third, institutional advantage, giving play to the institutional superiority of socialist countries, strengthening goal-driven, pooling consensus and joint efforts, optimizing resource allocation, and providing sustainable and solid guarantee for schools to accelerate catching up with the world's advanced level.

src: 特别要意识到，建设世界一流大学不可能千校一面，各个学校在发挥优势的同时，必须彰显个性和特色。

chosen.text: It should be noted that it is impossible to build a world-class university with a uniform style. While giving full play to their advantages, each school must highlight its individuality and characteristics.

src: 办学特色既要有共性的中国特色，也要体现各自独特的目标定位、办学传统和资源禀赋。

chosen.text: The characteristics of running a school should not only have common Chinese characteristics, but also reflect their respective unique target positioning, school-running traditions and resource endowments.

src: 就浙江大学而言，我们在办学中注重突出三个方面的特色：一是突出创新创业人才培养特色，构建科教融合、校企结合的整合育人环境，形成全链条的创业教育生态系统；二是突出学科交叉会聚特色，推动学科体系的优化调整，营造学科交叉的制度环境，积极培育交叉新兴学科和标志性交叉成果；三是突出办学体系和社会服务特色，开展深度国际交流合作，加快形成泛浙大产学研合作体系。

chosen.text: In the case of Zhejiang University, we focus on highlighting three aspects in our school-running: First, we highlight the characteristics of cultivating innovative and entrepreneurial talents, build an integrated educational environment of integrating science and education, and combining schools and enterprises, and form a full-chain entrepreneurship education ecosystem; second, we highlight the characteristics of cross-disciplinary convergence, promote the optimization and adjustment of the discipline system, create a cross-disciplinary institutional environment, and actively cultivate emerging interdisciplinary disciplines and landmark cross-disciplinary achievements; third, we highlight the characteristics of the school-running system and social services, carry out in-depth international exchanges and cooperation, and accelerate the formation of a Pan-Zhejiang University industry-university-research cooperation system.

src: 在这个过程中，尤为重要的是，要始终坚守大学精神，让大学精神与时代精神同频共振。

chosen.text: In this process, it is particularly important to always adhere to the university spirit and make the university spirit resonate with the spirit of the times.

src: 对于浙江大学来说 ， “ 求是创新”校训 ， “ 勤学、修德、明辨、笃实”共同价值观以及“海纳江河、启真厚德、开物前民、树我邦国”共同构成了浙大精神的最新表述体系。

chosen.text: For Zhejiang University, the school motto of "seeking truth and innovation", the common values of "studying hard, cultivating virtue, making a clear distinction, and being earnest", and "embracing rivers and lakes, enlightening truth and virtue, opening up things for the people, and building our country" together constitute the latest expression system of Zhejiang University spirit.

src: 这是学校坚持正确办学方向，不断积累文化高度、凝聚精神力量的重要保障，内涵丰富，意义深远。

chosen.text: This is an important guarantee for the school to adhere to the correct direction of running a school, continuously accumulate cultural height and gather spiritual strength, which is rich in connotation and far-reaching in significance.

src: 其中 ， “ 海纳江河”强调的是开放包容精神，体现以“天下英才为我所用”的胸怀，表现为汲取世界名校办学育人的优质理念 ； “ 启真厚德”强调的是求真至善精神，指的是大学在追求真理的同时，更当领受德行的陶冶和人格的砥砺 ； “ 开物前民”体现的是改革创新精神，既包含知识的求新，科研的创新，又表现为改革发展，革故鼎新 ； “ 树我邦国”强调的是爱国奉献精神，讲的是大学应当始终与民族命运同荣共辱。

chosen.text: Among them, "Haina River" emphasizes the spirit of openness and inclusiveness, reflects the mind of "using talents from all over the world", and is manifested as drawing on the high-quality concepts of running schools and educating people of world-famous universities; "Qizhen Houde" emphasizes the spirit of truth-seeking and goodness, which means that while pursuing truth, universities should also receive moral cultivation and personality; "Kaiwu Qianmin" reflects the spirit of reform and innovation, which includes the pursuit of knowledge, scientific research innovation, and is manifested as reform and development, and the overthrow of the old and the establishment of the new; "Shuwo Bangguo" emphasizes the spirit of patriotism and dedication, which means that universities should always be with the nation's destiny.

src: 这一系列精神理念和价值追求，正是浙江大学120年办学的灵魂所在。

chosen.text: This series of spiritual concepts and value pursuits is the soul of Zhejiang University's 120-year history.

src: “聪者听于无声，明者见于未形 ” 。

chosen.text: “The wise listen to the silent, and the bright see the unformed.”

src: 中国高校当进一步立足中国特色社会主义事业全局，深刻把握高等教育事业所处的时代方位和肩负的历史使命，加快建设成为世界一流大学。

chosen.text: China’s universities should further base themselves on the overall situation of socialism with Chinese characteristics, deeply understand the historical mission and position of higher education, and accelerate their development into world-class universities.

src: 同时，坚守人文关怀和独立自由，让大学精神与时代精神、民族精神互相激荡，从而为实现国家富强和民族振兴，实现人类的共同理想提供不竭的动力。

chosen.text: At the same time, we should adhere to humanistic care and independence, so that the university spirit and the spirit of the times and national spirit can interact with each other, thus providing an inexhaustible driving force for achieving national prosperity and rejuvenation and realizing the common ideal of mankind.

src: 习近平指出，当今世界正经历百年未有之大变局，全球科技创新进入密集活跃期，新一轮科技革命和产业变革对全球经济结构产生了深刻影响。

src: 广西大学生休学创业年限最长可达５年-新华网

chosen.text: The maximum length of time for Guangxi university students to take a break from school to start a business is five years - Xinhuanet

src: 新华社南宁５月１９日专电（记者张莺）记者近日从广西壮族自治区教育厅获悉，今后广西各高校将实施弹性学制，放宽大学生休学年限，在校生休学创业的年限在原有学制基础上可延长２至５年，休学创业时间可视为实践教育时间。

chosen.text: Xinhua News Agency, Nanning, May 19 (Reporter Zhang Ying) The reporter learned from the Education Department of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region that in the future, Guangxi universities will implement flexible academic systems, relax the length of time for college students to take a break from school, and extend the length of time for students to take a break from school to start a business by 2 to 5 years on the basis of the original academic system. The time taken to take a break from school to start a business can be regarded as practical education time.

src: 为促进大学生创业创新能力提升，广西教育、人社等部门合力搭建创业平台，建设更多大学生校外实践教学基地、大学科技园、大学生创业园、创业孵化基地等，给大学生创业提供外在保障。

chosen.text: In order to promote the improvement of college students' entrepreneurship and innovation ability, Guangxi Education, Human Resources and Social Security and other departments have jointly built an entrepreneurial platform, built more off-campus practice teaching bases for college students, university science parks, college students' business parks, business incubation bases, etc., and provided external guarantees for college students' entrepreneurship.

src: 根据要求，到２０２０年，各高校创新创业实践基地面积，本科学校要达到３０００平方米以上，高职学校要达到２０００平方米以上。

chosen.text: According to the requirements, by 2020, the area of innovation and entrepreneurship practice bases in colleges and universities should be more than 3,000 square meters for undergraduate schools and more than 2,000 square meters for higher vocational schools.

src: 政府鼓励高校设立创新创业学分，优先支持在创新创业实践中表现优异的学生转专业。

chosen.text: The government encourages colleges and universities to establish innovation and entrepreneurship credits, and gives priority to supporting students who perform excellently in innovation and entrepreneurship practice to change their majors.

src: 高校教师每两年要至少有两个月到行业企业挂职锻炼，以此提高教师创新创业教育的意识和能力。

chosen.text: University teachers should be assigned to work in industry and enterprises for at least two months every two years, so as to improve their awareness and ability of innovation and entrepreneurship education.

src: 自治区教育厅要求广西各高校深入实施大学生创新创业训练计划，力争使每一名大学生在校期间都参与一项创新创业训练计划。

chosen.text: The Education Department of the autonomous region requires all colleges and universities in Guangxi to implement the innovation and entrepreneurship training plan for college students, and strive to make every college student participate in an innovation and entrepreneurship training plan during their school years.

src: 高校要积极组织学生参加各级各类创新创业竞赛，并给予经费支持。

chosen.text: Colleges and universities should actively organize students to participate in various innovation and entrepreneurship competitions at all levels, and provide financial support.

src: NEWS GOV-MO: 澳大向7位杰出人士颁授荣誉博士学位

chosen.text: NEWS GOV-MO: UM Honours Seven Distinguished Persons with Honorary Doctorates

src: 澳门大学今（11）日举行“2021年荣誉学位及高等学位颁授典礼 ＂ ， 向刘遵义、陈凯先、中村修二、李兰娟、李效良、朱丽兰及江朝晖颁授澳大荣誉博士学位，以表彰其卓越成就、为社会和教育的发展所作出的重大贡献。

chosen.text: The University of Macau (UM) held the "2021 Honorary Degree and Advanced Degree Award Ceremony" today (11), awarding honorary doctorates to Liu Zunyi, Chen Kaixian, Shuji Nakamura, Li Lanjuan, Li Xiaoliang, Zhu Lilan and Jiang Zhaohui in recognition of their outstanding achievements and significant contributions to the development of society and education.

src: 颁授典礼上，行政长官兼澳大校监代表、社会文化司司长欧阳瑜在澳大校董会主席林金城、澳大校长宋永华陪同下颁授荣誉博士学位。

chosen.text: At the award ceremony, Chief Executive and representative of the University of Macau Council, Secretary for Social Affairs and Culture Ouyang Yu presented honorary doctorate degrees in the presence of President of the University of Macau Council, Lin Jin Cheng, and President of the University of Macau, Song Yonghua.

src: 刘遵义教授获颁荣誉教育博士学位、陈凯先教授获颁荣誉理学博士学位、中村修二教授获颁荣誉理学博士学位、李兰娟教授获颁荣誉理学博士学位、李效良教授获颁荣誉工商管理博士学位、朱丽兰教授获颁荣誉理学博士学位，江朝晖女士获颁荣誉理学博士学位。

chosen.text: Professor Liu Zunyi was awarded an honorary Doctor of Education, Professor Chen Kaixian was awarded an honorary Doctor of Science, Professor Nakamura Shuji was awarded an honorary Doctor of Science, Professor Li Lanjuan was awarded an honorary Doctor of Science, Professor Li Xiaoliang was awarded an honorary Doctor of Business Administration, Professor Zhu Lilan was awarded an honorary Doctor of Science, and Ms. Jiang Zhaohui was awarded an honorary Doctor of Science.

src: 欧阳瑜致辞时首先向获颁发荣誉博士学位的七位杰出人士，表示热烈的祝贺并致以崇高的敬意，他们分别在不同的领域取得非凡的成就，为国家的发展和世界的进步作出了卓越的贡献；同时，欧阳瑜向毕业生和家长表达最真挚的祝福，也向大学爱岗敬业、学术精湛的教职员团队致以由衷的敬意。

chosen.text: In his speech, Ouyang Yu first extended warm congratulations and high respect to the seven outstanding individuals who were awarded honorary doctorates. They have achieved extraordinary success in different fields and made outstanding contributions to national development and world progress. At the same time, Ouyang Yu expressed his sincere blessings to the graduates and parents, as well as his heartfelt respect to the university’s dedicated and highly skilled faculty team.

src: 澳大人文学院讲座教授孙艺风宣读刘遵义赞辞时表示，刘遵义教授是一位享誉全球的经济学家，以其卓越的学术成就和前瞻性的教育理念而闻名。

chosen.text: Sun Yifeng, a chair professor of the Faculty of Humanities at the University of Macau, said in his eulogy for Professor Liu Zunyi that Professor Liu Zunyi is a globally renowned economist, known for his outstanding academic achievements and forward-looking educational concepts.

src: 除了在经济发展、经济增长及东亚经济领域取得的成就外，他还是一位富有远见的教育领导者。

chosen.text: In addition to his achievements in economic development, economic growth and East Asian economy, he is also a far-sighted educational leader.

src: 简而言之，他在众多领域都有杰出建树。

chosen.text: In short, he was an outstanding man in so many areas.

src: 孙艺风宣读中村修二赞辞时表示，中村修二教授是可持续能源技术的先驱者。

chosen.text: Sun Yifeng read the eulogy of Shuji Nakamura, saying that Professor Shuji Nakamura is a pioneer in sustainable energy technology.

src: 他因发明蓝色发光二极管（LED）而成为2014年诺贝尔物理学奖的三位获奖者之一。

chosen.text: He was one of three people awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics in 2014 for inventing the blue light-emitting diode (LED).

src: 中村教授的发明不仅彻底改变了照明行业，更推动产生了如今广泛应用于日常生活和工业生产的白色发光二极管，为人类的福祉做出了巨大的贡献。

chosen.text: Professor Nakamura’s invention not only completely changed the lighting industry, but also promoted the production of white light-emitting diodes that are widely used in daily life and industrial production today, making a great contribution to human well-being.

src: 孙艺风宣读李兰娟赞辞时表示，李兰娟教授作为中国人工肝事业的开拓者，创建独特有效的李氏人工肝系统，治疗重型肝炎肝衰竭获重大突破，显著降低肝衰竭的病死率。

chosen.text: Sun Yifeng read out the praise for Li Lanjuan, saying that Professor Li Lanjuan, as a pioneer of artificial liver in China, created a unique and effective artificial liver system, made major breakthroughs in treating severe hepatitis and liver failure, and significantly reduced the mortality rate of liver failure.

src: 在这次新冠肺炎抗击战中，她和团队所提出的“四抗二平衡”方案及带去的人工肝、微生态和干细胞三大技术，显著提高了重症救治率。

chosen.text: In this battle against COVID-19, the "Four Resistances and Two Balances" plan proposed by her and her team, as well as the three technologies of artificial liver, microecology and stem cells, have significantly increased the treatment rate of severe cases.

src: 孙艺风宣读李效良赞辞时表示，李效良教授为运营管理的创新研究奠定了基础，塑造了供应链理论和实践的思维方式，并彻底改变了世界各地的商业模式。

chosen.text: In his reading of Professor Li’s eulogy, Sun Yifeng said that Professor Li laid the foundation for innovative research in operations management, shaped the way of thinking in supply chain theory and practice, and completely changed business models around the world.

src: 李效良因普及运筹管理中的长鞭效应概念而闻名，并探索了应对这种现象的措施。

chosen.text: Lee is known for popularizing the concept of the bullwhip effect in operations management and exploring measures to counter it.

src: 如今，各国在疫情及紧张的经济局势下，长鞭效应愈发突显，引发供应链严重破坏。

chosen.text: Today, under the epidemic and tense economic situation, the bullwhip effect is more prominent in various countries, causing serious damage to the supply chain.

src: 李效良具有远见的研究如雪中送炭，帮助行业应对困境，从而带来巨大的社会价值。

chosen.text: The far-sighted research of Li Xiaoliang is like timely help, helping the industry to cope with difficulties and thus bringing great social value.

src: 孙艺风宣读朱丽兰赞辞时表示，在科研工作中，她发现了一种突破性和创新的染色技术用于制备样品，在国内外科技同行中享有较高声誉。

chosen.text: In reading Zhu Lilan’s eulogy, Sun Yifeng said that in her scientific research work, she discovered a breakthrough and innovative staining technique for sample preparation, which enjoys high reputation among domestic and foreign peers.

src: 她以非凡的科技成就荣膺国际欧亚科学院院士等重要荣誉称号，以自己辉煌的业绩为自己在世界科技圣殿赢得了应有的崇高地位。

chosen.text: She was honored with important honorary titles such as academician of the International Eurasian Academy of Sciences for her extraordinary scientific and technological achievements, and won the lofty status that she deserved in the world's science and technology temple with her brilliant achievements.

src: 澳大中华医药研究院代院长陈新宣读陈凯先赞辞时表示，陈凯先教授从事药物研发40余载，杰出的科学成就以及对国家、澳门、澳门大学、国家重点实验室的重要贡献使其拥有崇高的国际地位和声望。

chosen.text: Chen Xin, acting dean of the Macao University of Chinese Medicine, read out the eulogy of Professor Chen Kai-sun, saying that Professor Chen Kai-sun has been engaged in drug research and development for more than 40 years, and his outstanding scientific achievements and important contributions to the country, Macao, the University of Macao and the national key laboratory have given him a lofty international status and reputation.

src: 他对澳门和大湾区中医药事业发展的积极推动作用充分体现了其为国家医药发展战略奉献的使命感。

chosen.text: The Asian Education Coalition, which led the appeal, held a press conference in Washington on the same day.

src: 该团体主席赵宇空在发布会上说，过去１０年里，符合美国名校录取条件的亚裔申请人数量成倍增长，但在这３所美国名校中，亚裔所占比例基本维持在同一水平。

chosen.text: Zhao Yukong, the chairman of the group, said at the press conference that in the past 10 years, the number of Asian applicants who meet the admission requirements of American prestigious universities has doubled, but among these three American prestigious universities, the proportion of Asians has remained basically the same.

src: 许多研究表明，这些高校在所谓“综合考量”的招生过程中 ， “ 长期持续性以及系统化地歧视亚裔申请学生 ” 。

chosen.text: Many studies have shown that these universities "systematically and persistently discriminate against Asian applicants" in the so-called "comprehensive consideration" admissions process.

src: 赵宇空介绍说，２０１４年桑德斯等学者的研究显示，在这３所高校里，相对申请者人数，亚裔在所有族裔中录取率最低。

chosen.text: According to Zhao Yukong, a 2014 study by Sanders and other scholars showed that among these three universities, the acceptance rate of Asians was the lowest among all ethnic groups relative to the number of applicants.

src: 美国教育部的数据也显示，在所有常春藤盟校中，布朗大学和达特茅斯学院对亚裔学生的录取比例最低，耶鲁大学和布朗大学对亚裔申请学生实施了事实上的种族配额达２０年以上。

chosen.text: Data from the U.S. Department of Education also shows that Brown University and Dartmouth College have the lowest acceptance rates for Asian students among all Ivy League schools, and Yale University and Brown University have implemented de facto racial quotas for Asian applicants for more than 20 years.

src: 赵宇空告诉新华社记者，他们期望提交申诉后，美国教育部、司法部能够展开调查，并在认定事实后采取措施阻止这些高校继续在招生中歧视亚裔。

chosen.text: Zhao Yukong told Xinhua News Agency that they expect the U.S. Department of Education and Justice to launch an investigation after submitting the appeal, and take measures to prevent these universities from continuing to discriminate against Asians in enrollment after finding out the facts.

src: 他们也期望被投诉高校能够主动重视这一问题，改变对亚裔的招生政策。

chosen.text: They also expect the universities to take the initiative to address this issue and change their admissions policies for Asian students.

src: 目前，被投诉的３所高校尚未作出回应。

chosen.text: At present, the three universities that were complained about have not yet responded.

src: 亚裔教育联盟成立于２０１５年，当时曾投诉哈佛大学招生歧视，但美国教育部以程序理由未予受理。

chosen.text: The Asian Coalition for Educational Equity was established in 2015, and had complained of Harvard University's enrollment discrimination, but the US Department of Education did not accept it on procedural reasons.

src: 此次参与申诉的除美国华裔团体外，还包括美国印度裔、韩裔、日裔、巴基斯坦裔教育团体。

chosen.text: In addition to the Chinese-American groups, the Indian-American, Korean-American, Japanese-American and Pakistani-American education groups also participated in this appeal.

src: 2020年9月，陆先生从房屋中介了解到一处位于浙江余姚丈亭镇的厂房，在多次现场看房后，陆先生决定购买该厂房。

chosen.text: In September 2020, Mr. Lu learned from a real estate agent about a factory building in Zhangting Town, Yuyao, Zhejiang Province. After visiting the site several times, Mr. Lu decided to buy the factory building.

src: 同年12月，陆先生就购买厂房的细节与房屋所有权人的家属林某进行磋商后，于当天通过银行转账汇款20万元作定金。

chosen.text: In December of the same year, Mr. Lu negotiated with Lin, a family member of the property owner, on the details of the purchase of the factory building, and transferred 200,000 yuan as a deposit through bank transfer on the same day.

src: 林某在《厂房买卖定金收条》上作为收款人签名，其中载明，“若买方不想买此厂房，此定金归卖家，如卖方不愿意卖此厂房，定金将双倍返还卖方，双方约定一周内签订厂房买卖合同。”

chosen.text: Lin signed as the payee on the "Factory Building Purchase Deposit Receipt", which stated, "If the buyer does not want to buy this factory building, the deposit will be returned to the seller, and if the seller does not want to sell this factory building, the deposit will be doubled and returned to the seller, and both parties agreed to sign a factory building sales contract within one week."

src: 然而，之后双方因厂房出售范围、付款方式等主要合同条款未能形成一致意见，导致房屋买卖合同迟迟未能签订。

chosen.text: However, the two parties failed to reach a consensus on the main contract terms such as the scope of the sale of the factory building and the payment method, which led to the delay in signing the house sales contract.

src: 考虑到双方未能就合同内容达成共识，几天后，林某将20万元定金退回给了陆先生。

chosen.text: Considering that the two parties failed to reach a consensus on the contract content, Lin returned the 200,000 yuan deposit to Mr. Lu a few days later.

src: 好不容易看中的房子，定金交了，房款也准备好了，就差“临门一脚”签合同，卖方却不卖了，这让陆先生无奈又愤怒。

chosen.text: Mr. Lu was helpless and angry because he finally found a house he liked, paid the deposit, and prepared the money for the house, but the seller refused to sell it.

src: 为此，陆先生将林某起诉至余姚市人民法院。

chosen.text: For this reason, Mr. Lu sued Mr. Lin to the People's Court of Yuyao City.

src: 法院经审理认为，双方最终未能签订正式合同，不能仅归责于被告，应合理推定为磋商不成，故本案不应适用定金罚则，被告无需承担双倍返还定金的违约责任。

chosen.text: The court held that the failure of the two parties to sign a formal contract should not be attributed solely to the defendant, and it should be reasonably presumed that the negotiation failed. Therefore, the deposit penalty rule should not be applied in this case, and the defendant did not need to bear the liability for breach of contract of double return of the deposit.

src: 一审判决后，原告提起上诉。

chosen.text: After the first-instance judgment, the plaintiff filed an appeal.

src: 近日，二审法院维持原判。

chosen.text: Recently, the second-instance court upheld the original judgment.

src: 【律师提醒】 在交易过程中要尽到必要的审慎注意义务。

chosen.text: [Lawyer's Reminder] You should fulfill the necessary duty of care during the transaction process.

src: 在签订合同时，作为买方要尽到必要的审慎注意义务，比如，核实房屋所有权人信息、房屋是否被人占用等相关信息，并在合同中明确关于交付的具体时间、地点，以防履行合同时双方产生争议。

chosen.text: When signing a contract, as a buyer, you should fulfill the necessary duty of care, such as verifying the information of the owner of the house, whether the house is occupied and other relevant information, and clearly define the specific time and place of delivery in the contract to prevent disputes between the two parties when performing the contract.

chosen.text: As a result, there is a "strange situation" that "poor students" can pass and even get high scores without investment; "top students" never miss classes, do homework and take notes well, but don't get much higher scores in exams.

src: 其实，上过大学的人都清楚，突击备考、想各种办法从老师处“套取”考题，争取划考试范围，求得考前得到“重点辅导”的现象并不少见，甚至在考试中夹带小抄、考后求老师高抬贵手的情况也不是奇闻。

chosen.text: In fact, those who have attended university know that cramming for exams, trying various ways to “get” exam questions from teachers, striving to draw the scope of the exam, and seeking “key guidance” before the exam are not uncommon, and even bringing in cheat sheets during the exam and asking teachers to be lenient after the exam are not strange.

src: 在笔者看来，作为一种教学质量评估导向，衡量一所大学考试的合格与否，更在于教师对教与学的全面把握，以及在此基础上的科学命题。

chosen.text: In my opinion, as a quality assessment orientation, whether a university passes an examination depends more on teachers' overall grasp of teaching and learning, and scientific proposition based on this.

src: 进入大学本科阶段，专业开始细分，很多专业课程以基础知识为主。

chosen.text: In the undergraduate stage, the majors begin to be subdivided, and many professional courses are based on basic knowledge.

src: 毋庸置疑，是否全面掌握一个学科的基本知识点，是大学考试要考察的内容。

chosen.text: Undoubtedly, whether a student has fully grasped the basic knowledge points of a subject is what university exams are designed to test.

src: 而本科知识基本都是学科基础理论和基本常识，从知识点而言，变化的空间并不大，基本是固定的。

chosen.text: Undergraduate knowledge is basically basic theory and common sense of disciplines, and there is not much room for change in terms of knowledge points, which are basically fixed.

src: 就像有教师所言 ， “ 20年前学大学数学的基本知识，现在还在学，还是重点 。 ”

chosen.text: As a teacher said, "The basic knowledge of college mathematics learned 20 years ago is still being studied now, and it is still the key point. "

src: 但知识点基本不变，并不代表考试题型单一、试题重复。

chosen.text: However, the fact that the knowledge points remain basically unchanged does not mean that the exam questions are of a single type and the test questions are repeated.

src: 在很多大学，考试一般都会组成出题组，再由学科资深教师统筹组成试卷，考试阅卷也由承担该科的全体老师参与，这样就能在一定程度上克服试题重复的情况。

chosen.text: In many universities, the examination is generally composed of a question group, and then the senior teachers of the subject will make up the test paper. The marking of the examination will also be participated by all teachers who are responsible for the subject, so that the repetition of the test questions can be overcome to a certain extent.

src: 但要拟出一套符合教与学实际的试题，题目根据学生学习整体情况，难易呈正态分布，还需综合掌握教学情况，全面分析学生学习的程度，从而使考试命题对难易、题型有动态把握，既能突出基础知识考察，又能兼顾能力考查，同时对题型进行创新设计。

chosen.text: However, to draw up a set of test questions that are in line with the actual situation of teaching and learning, the questions should be based on the overall situation of students' learning, and the difficulty should be normally distributed. It is also necessary to comprehensively master the teaching situation and comprehensively analyze the degree of students' learning, so that the examination proposition has dynamic control over the difficulty and question types, which can not only highlight the basic knowledge inspection, but also take into account the ability inspection, and at the same time innovate the question types.

src: 考试是大学教育的指挥棒，有什么样的考试，学生就会有相应的备考方案，长此以往，将影响大学教育的成效。

chosen.text: Examination is the baton of university education. What kind of examination students have, they will have corresponding preparation plans. In the long run, it will affect the effectiveness of university education.

src: 对于学生的建议信，兰州交大校方高度重视，已在全校部署了整改的方案。

chosen.text: Lanzhou Jiaotong University has attached great importance to the letter of advice from students and has deployed a rectification plan throughout the university.

src: 要求各教学单位组织教师开展研讨和课程结课考试对照自查，制定考试试卷命题及相关制度，同时加强对考试试卷命题及审核环节的监督与检查，细化成绩评定，加强课程教学各环节的全面考核。

chosen.text: It requires all teaching units to organize teachers to carry out discussions and self-examinations of course final exams, formulate examination papers and related systems, strengthen the supervision and inspection of examination paper proposition and review, refine the assessment of grades, and strengthen the comprehensive assessment of all links in course teaching.

src: 从机制上解决试题类型单一、题目重复等问题是大学考务需要面对的议题，当然需要出台相应的制度，但功夫贵在日常，需要教师对教学情况的全面掌握，不单要吃透教学内容，更须吃透学生学习情况，两头吃透，教与学将更好对接，形成良性互动，考试也将更加符合实际，从而让“学霸”和“学渣”各得其所。

chosen.text: Mechanically solving problems such as single question types and repeated questions is an issue that university examination affairs need to face. Of course, corresponding systems should be introduced, but the key lies in daily efforts. Teachers need to have a comprehensive grasp of teaching situations. They should not only thoroughly understand the teaching content, but also thoroughly understand the students' learning situation. With thorough understanding of both sides, teaching and learning will be better connected, forming a positive interaction, and the examination will be more in line with reality, so that "top students" and "poor students" can get what they deserve.

src: “实现了‘十四五’良好开局 ” ， 12月8日至10日举行的中央经济工作会议高度评价一年来我国经济社会发展取得的成绩。

chosen.text: "Realize a good start of the 14th Five-Year Plan", the Central Economic Work Conference held from December 8 to 10 highly appraised the achievements made by China's economic and social development over the past year.

src: 习近平总书记在会上发表重要讲话，深刻总结2021年经济工作，深入分析当前经济形势，对2022年经济工作作出重大部署，为我们做好明年经济工作，迎接党的二十大胜利召开，指明了前进方向、提供了根本遵循。

chosen.text: General Secretary Xi Jinping delivered an important speech at the meeting, profoundly summarized the economic work in 2021, analyzed the current economic situation in depth, and made major arrangements for the economic work in 2022, which pointed out the direction of progress and provided fundamental guidance for us to do a good job in next year's economic work and welcome the successful convening of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China.

src: 我们隆重庆祝中国共产党成立一百周年，正式宣布全面建成小康社会、实现第一个百年奋斗目标，开启全面建设社会主义现代化国家、向第二个百年奋斗目标进军新征程。

chosen.text: We celebrate the centenary of the founding of the Communist Party of China, officially announce the completion of building a moderately prosperous society in all respects and achieve the first centenary goal, and embark on a new journey to build a modern socialist country in all respects and march towards the second centenary goal.

src: 我们召开党的十九届六中全会，总结党的百年奋斗重大成就和历史经验，通过百年党史上第三个历史决议《中共中央关于党的百年奋斗重大成就和历史经验的决议 》 ， 这是新时代中国共产党人牢记初心使命、坚持和发展中国特色社会主义的政治宣言，是以史为鉴、开创未来、实现中华民族伟大复兴的行动指南。

chosen.text: We convened the Sixth Plenary Session of the 19th CPC Central Committee to summarize the major achievements and historical experience of the Party's century-long struggle, and adopted the third historical resolution in the history of the Party, the Resolution of the CPC Central Committee on the Major Achievements and Historical Experience of the Party's Centenary Struggle. This is a political declaration for the Chinese Communists in the new era to keep their original mission in mind, adhere to and develop socialism with Chinese characteristics, and it is also an action guide for taking history as a mirror, creating the future, and realizing the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.

src: 一年来，世界百年未有之大变局和新冠肺炎疫情全球大流行交织影响，外部环境更趋复杂严峻，国内新冠肺炎疫情防控和经济社会发展各项任务极为繁重艰巨。

chosen.text: Over the past year, the world has seen a major change that has not occurred in a century and the global pandemic of COVID-19 have intertwined and affected each other, making the external environment more complex and severe, and the tasks of preventing and controlling the COVID-19 epidemic and economic and social development are extremely heavy and arduous.

src: 以习近平同志为核心的党中央坚持统筹国内国际两个大局，坚持稳中求进工作总基调，沉着应对百年变局和世纪疫情，统筹疫情防控和经济社会发展，加快构建新发展格局，强化宏观政策跨周期调节，着力促进经济持续健康发展，着力深化改革开放创新，奋力完成改革发展艰巨任务，党和国家各项事业取得了新的重大成就。

chosen.text: The Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping as the core has adhered to the overall planning of domestic and international situations, the general keynote of seeking progress while maintaining stability, calmly responded to the changes in the past century and the pandemic in the 21st century, coordinated epidemic prevention and control with economic and social development, accelerated the construction of a new development pattern, strengthened the cross-cycle adjustment of macro policies, focused on promoting sustainable and healthy economic development, focused on deepening reform, opening up and innovation, and strived to complete the arduous tasks of reform and development, and achieved new major achievements in all undertakings of the Party and the country.

src: “十四五”实现良好开局，一个重要方面体现在，构建新发展格局迈出新步伐，高质量发展取得新成效。

chosen.text: A good start has been made in the 14th Five-Year Plan, which is reflected in the new steps taken to build a new development pattern and the new achievements made in high-quality development.

src: 我国经济发展和疫情防控保持全球领先地位，发展韧性强、潜力大、动力足的特点持续显现；国家战略科技力量加快壮大，重大创新成果竞相涌现，科技创新能力持续提升，关键核心技术攻关实现新突破；产业链韧性得到提升，对外贸易量增质升，结构继续优化，以新产业新业态新模式为代表的新动能成长壮大；改革开放向纵深推进，着力打通制约供需适配和要素流动的堵点，以高水平对外开放打造合作竞争新优势；民生保障有力有效，就业规模持续扩大，居民收入增长与经济增长基本同步，全年粮食连续7年保持在1.3万亿斤以上，喜获“十八连丰 ” ； 生态文明建设持续推进，碳达峰碳中和工作统筹推进，绿色低碳转型步伐稳健，生态环境保护取得新成效。

chosen.text: China’s economic development and epidemic prevention and control have maintained a leading position in the world, with strong resilience, great potential and sufficient momentum; national strategic scientific and technological forces have been rapidly strengthened, major innovation achievements have emerged, scientific and technological innovation capabilities have been continuously enhanced, and key core technologies have achieved new breakthroughs; the resilience of the industrial chain has been enhanced, foreign trade volume has increased and quality has improved, the structure has continued to be optimized, and new kinetic energy represented by new industries, new formats and new models has grown and expanded; reform and opening up have been advanced in depth, efforts have been made to remove the blockages that restrict supply and demand adaptation and factor flow, and new advantages in cooperation and competition have been created through high-level opening up; people’s livelihoods have been effectively guaranteed, employment scale has continued to expand, residents’ income growth has been basically synchronized with economic growth, grain production has remained above 1.3 trillion catties for seven consecutive years, and China has achieved “eighteen consecutive harvests”; ecological civilization construction has been continuously promoted, carbon peak and carbon neutrality work has been coordinated, green and low-carbon transformation has been steady, and new achievements have been made in ecological environment protection.

src: 这些成绩的取得，是以习近平同志为核心的党中央坚强领导的结果，是习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想科学指引的结果，是全党全国各族人民勠力同心、艰苦奋斗的结果。

chosen.text: These achievements are the result of the strong leadership of the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping as the core, the result of the scientific guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, and the result of the concerted efforts and hard work of the whole Party and people of all ethnic groups in the country.

src: 实践再次证明，党确立习近平同志党中央的核心、全党的核心地位，确立习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想的指导地位，对新时代党和国家事业发展、对推进中华民族伟大复兴历史进程具有决定性意义。

chosen.text: Practice has once again proved that the Party's establishment of Comrade Xi Jinping as the core of the Party Central Committee and the whole Party, and the establishment of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era as the guiding ideology, is of decisive significance to the development of the cause of the Party and the country in the new era and to the historical process of promoting the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.

src: 有习近平总书记作为党中央的核心、全党的核心领航掌舵，有习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想科学指引，有全党全国各族人民团结一心、顽强奋斗，我们就一定能够战胜各种艰难险阻，在全面建设社会主义现代化国家新征程上创造新的时代辉煌、铸就新的历史伟业。

chosen.text: With General Secretary Xi Jinping as the core of the Party Central Committee and the whole Party, with the scientific guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, and with the unity and tenacious struggle of the whole Party and people of all ethnic groups in the country, we will surely be able to overcome all kinds of difficulties and obstacles, and create new glories of the times and build new historical achievements on the new journey of building a modern socialist country in an all-round way.

src: 明年将召开党的二十大，这是党和国家政治生活中的一件大事。

chosen.text: The 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China will be held next year, which is a major event in the political life of the Party and the country.

src: 弘扬伟大建党精神，坚持稳中求进工作总基调，完整、准确、全面贯彻新发展理念，加快构建新发展格局，全面深化改革开放，坚持创新驱动发展，推动高质量发展，坚持以供给侧结构性改革为主线，统筹疫情防控和经济社会发展，统筹发展和安全，继续做好“六稳 ” 、 “六保”工作，持续改善民生，着力稳定宏观经济大盘，保持经济运行在合理区间，保持社会大局稳定，我们就一定能保持平稳健康的经济环境、国泰民安的社会环境、风清气正的政治环境，以优异成绩迎接党的二十大胜利召开。

chosen.text: We should carry forward the great spirit of building the Party, adhere to the general keynote of seeking progress while maintaining stability, implement the new development concept in a complete, accurate and comprehensive manner, accelerate the construction of a new development pattern, comprehensively deepen reform and opening up, adhere to innovation-driven development, promote high-quality development, adhere to supply-side structural reform as the main line, coordinate epidemic prevention and control with economic and social development, coordinate development and security, continue to do a good job in "six stabilities" and "six guarantees", continuously improve people's livelihoods, focus on stabilizing the macro economy, keep the economy operating within a reasonable range, and maintain social stability. Then we will surely be able to maintain a stable and healthy economic environment, a peaceful and prosperous social environment, and a clean and upright political environment, and welcome the successful convening of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China with excellent achievements.

src: 让我们更加紧密地团结在以习近平同志为核心的党中央周围，增强“四个意识 ” 、 坚定“四个自信 ” 、 做到“两个维护 ” ， 不断提高政治判断力、政治领悟力、政治执行力，以实际行动把党中央决策部署落实到位，不断把新时代中国特色社会主义事业推向前进。

chosen.text: Let us unite more closely around the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping as the core, enhance the "Four Consciousnesses", strengthen the "Four Spheres of Confidence", and achieve the "Two Upholds", continuously improve political judgment, political comprehension, and political execution, implement the decisions and arrangements of the Party Central Committee in actual actions, and continue to push forward the cause of socialism with Chinese characteristics in the new era.

src: 教育资讯：北京压缩2016年初中入学特长生比例-新华网

chosen.text: Education News: Beijing Compresses the Proportion of Junior High School Students with Special Skills in 2016 - Xinhuanet

src: 21日、22日两日，北京市初中入学特长生考查工作由各区教委统一组织实施。

chosen.text: On September 21 and 22, the examination of junior high school students in Beijing was organized and implemented by the Education Commission of each district.

src: 今年，北京各区均压缩了特长生招生比例，特长生竞争更为激烈。

chosen.text: This year, all districts in Beijing have compressed the proportion of special students, and the competition for special students has become more intense.

src: 以东城区为例，今年该区小学升初中特长生入学比例总体不超过全区招生计划数的5 % ， 计划招生人数为380人，到校比例不超过学校招生计划数的10 % 。

chosen.text: Taking Dongcheng District as an example, this year, the proportion of students with special skills in primary schools to junior high schools in this district will not exceed 5% of the total enrollment plan, and the planned enrollment number is 380. The proportion of students who arrive at school will not exceed 10% of the school's enrollment plan.

src: 凡具有体育、艺术、科技特长且在网上报名的学生均有资格参加特长生招生考查。

chosen.text: Students who have sports, art, and technology expertise and who register online are eligible to participate in the special talent enrollment examination.

src: 为方便学生就近参加考查，东城区延续去年的考查安排方式，在每个学区分别设置1~2个考查地点，共13个考查地点。

chosen.text: In order to facilitate students to take the examination nearby, Dongcheng District continued last year's arrangement of the examination, and set up 1-2 examination sites in each school district, a total of 13 examination sites.

src: 考点均按考区划分考场，以小时为单位划分时段，考查当天学生将按时段进入考点在不同考区考场内进行考查。

chosen.text: The examination points are divided into examination rooms according to the examination areas, and the time periods are divided by hours. The students will enter the examination points on the day of the examination according to the time periods to take the examinations in different examination rooms of the examination areas.

src: 5月23日，区教育招生考试中心网上公示考查通过的学生名单，学生可在网上查询考查结果。

chosen.text: On May 23, the list of students who passed the examination was publicly displayed online by the District Education Enrollment and Examination Center, and students can query the examination results online.

src: 会见时，克韦西奇积极评价波中关系并表示，他曾于2008年北京夏奥会之际访华，对中方出色的组织工作印象极为深刻，坚信中国有能力在特殊时期办好冬奥盛会；波方十分期待北京冬奥会，波黑奥委会正在积极组织参会；波方希望以此为契机，同中方在体育领域开展更为广泛的交流合作。

chosen.text: During the meeting, Kvesic spoke highly of China-Croatia relations and said that he had visited China on the occasion of the 2008 Beijing Summer Olympics and was deeply impressed by the excellent organization work of China. He firmly believed that China has the ability to host the Winter Olympic Games in a special period; Croatia is very much looking forward to the Beijing Winter Olympics, and the BiH Olympic Committee is actively organizing participation; Croatia hopes to take this as an opportunity to carry out more extensive exchanges and cooperation with China in the field of sports.

src: 季平表示，中波两国有着特殊的“奥运纽带 ” 。

src: 1984年萨拉热窝冬奥会在这里成功举办，再过两个月，2022年北京冬奥会也将拉开帷幕，将向世界呈现一场简约、安全、精彩的盛会。

chosen.text: The 1984 Winter Olympics in Sarajevo was successfully held here, and in two months, the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics will also be opened, which will present a simple, safe and wonderful event to the world.

src: 期待两国在冬季体育赛事筹备、运动员训练等方面深化交流合作，中国驻波黑使馆愿继续发挥桥梁作用，以北京冬奥会为契机，推动两国人文交流不断深化，让两国人民“一起向未来 ” ， 并祝波黑运动健儿在北京取得佳绩。

chosen.text: It is expected that the two countries will deepen exchanges and cooperation in winter sports events, athlete training, etc. The Chinese Embassy in Bosnia and Herzegovina is willing to continue to play a bridging role, take the Beijing Winter Olympics as an opportunity, promote the continuous deepening of cultural exchanges between the two countries, let the people of the two countries "move forward together", and wish the athletes of Bosnia and Herzegovina good results in Beijing.
