src: 48小时核酸阴性、设“缓冲区 ” 国务院联防联控机制发文要求加强口岸城市疫情防控-新华网

chosen.text: 48-hour nucleic acid negative, set up a "buffer zone", the State Council's Joint Prevention and Control Mechanism issued a document requiring the strengthening of port city epidemic prevention and control - Xinhuanet

src: 新华社北京12月11日电（记者董瑞丰、顾天成）国务院联防联控机制日前印发关于加强口岸城市新冠肺炎疫情防控工作的通知，要求近期离开陆地边境口岸城市（与香港、澳门有口岸相连的除外）人员需持有48小时内核酸检测阴性证明，前往陆地边境口岸城市人员抵达后至少进行1次核酸检测。

chosen.text: Xinhua News Agency, Beijing, December 11 (Reporters Dong Ruifeng and Gu Tiancheng) The Joint Prevention and Control Mechanism of the State Council recently issued a notice on strengthening the prevention and control of COVID-19 in port cities, requiring that those who leave land border port cities (except for those connected to Hong Kong and Macao) should hold a negative nucleic acid test certificate within 48 hours, and those who go to land border port cities should have at least one nucleic acid test after arrival.

src: 根据通知，上述要求的时间范围为，从各省区市确定口岸城市范围并公告之日起，至2022年3月15日。

chosen.text: According to the notice, the above requirements are valid from the date when each province, autonomous region and municipality determines the scope of port cities and announces it to March 15, 2022.

src: 此外，通知还提出，有条件的口岸城市可研究在辖区内设置疫情防控缓冲区。

chosen.text: In addition, the notice also proposed that port cities with conditions may study setting up a buffer zone for epidemic prevention and control within their jurisdiction.

src: 国家卫生健康委疾病预防控制局有关负责人介绍，对于一些口岸城市来说，跨境边贸是当地主要经济支柱，双方边民往来频繁。

chosen.text: According to the relevant person in charge of the Disease Prevention and Control Bureau of the National Health Commission, for some port cities, cross-border border trade is the main economic pillar, and the border people of both sides come and go frequently.

src: 实行分区差异化管理政策，由一道防控外溢防线变为两道防线，有望实现关口前移，压缩疫情外溢风险，以最小社会影响、最低社会成本实现疫情防控最大成效。

chosen.text: Implementing a differentiated management policy for different regions, changing from one line of defense to two lines of defense, is expected to move the control points forward, compress the risk of epidemic overflow, and achieve the greatest effect in epidemic prevention and control with the least social impact and lowest social cost.

src: 近期我国发生多起本土聚集性疫情，均是境外疫情经口岸城市输入。

chosen.text: Recently, there have been several local clustered epidemics in China, which are all imported from overseas epidemics through port cities.

src: 上述通知指出，这暴露出一些地方疫情监测预警不及时、高风险岗位人员闭环管理不落实、定期核酸检测流于形式、冷链物品各环节消杀不到位、集中隔离场所管理不规范、疫情应急处置不够科学精准等问题。

chosen.text: The above-mentioned notice pointed out that this exposed some problems, such as untimely epidemic monitoring and early warning, non-implementation of closed-loop management for high-risk positions, formalities of regular nucleic acid testing, inadequate disinfection in all links of cold-chain items, irregular management of centralized isolation sites, and insufficient scientific and precise emergency handling of the epidemic.

src: 通知要求，从完善口岸城市疫情防控机制、健全疫情监测预警体系、落实边境管控措施等9个方面着力，加快补齐口岸城市防控短板弱项，毫不放松、科学精准做好防控工作，织密扎牢外防输入防线。

chosen.text: The notice requires that efforts should be made from nine aspects, including improving the port city epidemic prevention and control mechanism, improving the epidemic monitoring and early warning system, and implementing border control measures, to accelerate the completion of port city prevention and control shortfalls and weaknesses, and to do a good job in prevention and control work without relaxation, scientifically and accurately, and to tighten the defense line against imported diseases.

src: 通知强调，各口岸城市要将疫情防控与民生保障工作同步研究、同步部署，公布并畅通民生保障热线，定期排查基本生活物资供应、价格等方面的苗头隐患，及时解决和主动回应群众反映的突出问题。

chosen.text: The notice stressed that all port cities should study and deploy epidemic prevention and control and people's livelihood protection work simultaneously, announce and open up people's livelihood protection hotlines, regularly investigate the supply and price of basic living materials, and promptly solve and actively respond to prominent issues reflected by the masses.

src: 根据通知，其中所指的口岸城市包括开放的陆路、水路、航空口岸所在县（市、区、旗 ） 、 所在市（地、州、盟）及所在直辖市，具体范围由各省（自治区、直辖市）根据疫情防控需要确定并及时公告。

chosen.text: According to the notice, the port cities referred to include the counties (cities, districts, banners), cities (prefectures, prefectures, leagues) and municipalities directly under the Central Government where the open land, water and air ports are located. The specific scope shall be determined by each province (autonomous region, municipality directly under the Central Government) according to the needs of epidemic prevention and control and announced in a timely manner.

src: 现今的成功学书籍，很多宣扬的都是“最好原则 ” — —即先假定或暗示你能“做到 ” ， 然后再告诉你需要做到的事情“是什么 ” 。

chosen.text: Many of today's success books promote the "best principle" - that is, first assume or imply that you can "do", and then tell you what you need to do.

src: 等于说一下子越过了“如何做到”这个其实最重要、最根本的环节。

chosen.text: This means that we have skipped over the most important and fundamental link of "how to do it".

src: 正因如此，这些书都有一个共同的特点 — — 要么就一鼓作气地干到最好，要么就干脆什么也别干；要么就是100，要么就是0；要么你就登泰山，要么你就干脆在原地待着。

chosen.text: For this reason, these books have a common feature - either do it best in one go or don't do anything; either 100 or 0; either climb Mount Tai or stay in place.

src: 这种“最好原则 ” ， 让谁看都会承认“正确无比 ” ， 但是99%的人都会被吓倒在起跑线前。

chosen.text: This "best principle" is "absolutely correct" for anyone to see, but 99% of people will be scared away before the starting line.

src: 因为这种理论鼓吹的是一种“你要痛下决心，重新做人，来个180度的大转变”的路径，而这恰恰是很多人的致命弱项。

chosen.text: Because this theory advocates a path of "you have to make up your mind, change yourself, and make a 180-degree turn", which is exactly the fatal weakness of many people.

src: 对于墨守成规、因循守旧、拒绝变化的人，你偏偏要在他的耳旁大喊“你要转变 ” ， 无疑是自欺欺人、对牛弹琴之举。

chosen.text: For those who stick to old ways, refuse to change, you have to shout in his ear "you should change", which is undoubtedly self-deception and a waste of time.

src: 绝大多数人都会在“转变”两字面前露怯，裹足不前，难下决心；又或者凭着一时的冲动痛下了“转变”之决心，并勇敢地迈出了第一步，但往往是好景不长，坚持不了多一会儿就败下阵来，难见持续性。

chosen.text: Most people would be afraid of the word "change", and would be hesitant to make a decision; or they would make a decision to "change" on a whim, and bravely take the first step, but often the good times wouldn't last long, and they would fail after a while, and it would be hard to see sustainability.

src: 马三立先生那段著名的《从明天开始》的相声，就是最传神地表现了这一“普遍人性”的经典。

chosen.text: Mr. Ma Sanli’s famous cross-talk “Starting from Tomorrow” is a classic that vividly demonstrates this “universal human nature”.

src: “最好原则”的最大问题在于门槛太高，它往往超越了普通人的能力极限，让绝大多数人“望门兴叹 ” 。

chosen.text: The biggest problem with the "best principle" is that the threshold is too high, which often goes beyond the ability limit of ordinary people, making most people "sigh at the door".

src: 或许 ， “ 次好原则”才是一种有可能让更多普通人走上相对成功之路的途径。

chosen.text: Perhaps, the "second best principle" is a way that may lead more ordinary people to a relatively successful path.

src: “次好原则”的核心在于“降低门槛 ” — —它鼓励的是一种“积小胜为大胜”的理论，即如果做不到100，只做到1也行：因为1永远大于0；如果登不上泰山，只登上你家门口的小沙丘也行，因为那也总比原地踏步强。

chosen.text: The core of the "second best principle" is to "lower the threshold" - it encourages a theory of "accumulating small victories into big victories", that is, if you can't do 100, just do 1: because 1 is always greater than 0; if you can't climb Mount Tai, just climb the small sand dune in front of your house, because that's better than standing still.

src: 总之，只要你做了点什么，就总比不做强。

chosen.text: In short, if you do something, it is better than not doing anything.

src: 由于门槛大幅度降低，因此就多了使普通人做到坚持的可能性，而凡事只要坚持，成功概率也会加大。

chosen.text: Since the threshold has been greatly reduced, there is a greater possibility of making ordinary people persevere, and as long as they persevere, the probability of success will increase.

src: 只不过遵循“次好原则”的成功之路，其路程略长一些而已。

chosen.text: It's just that the road to success following the "second best" principle is a little longer.

src: 总而言之 ， “ 最好原则”尽管在表面上打着让所有人都成功的旗号，但它最终能够激励的，实际上还是少数；而“次好原则 ” ， 才能有效激励更多的人，尽可能地让更多人受益。

chosen.text: In short, although the "best principle" is ostensibly designed to make everyone successful, it can ultimately motivate only a small number of people; while the "second best principle" can effectively motivate more people and benefit as many people as possible.

src: 青海湖裸鲤资源蕴藏量今年增加0.71万吨-新华网

chosen.text: The resource reserve of Qinghai Lake naked fish increased by 7,100 tons this year - Xinhuanet

src: 新华社西宁12月11日电（记者骆晓飞、张宏祥）记者从青海省农业农村厅获悉，最新监测结果显示，青海湖裸鲤资源蕴藏量今年较上年增加0.71万吨,达到10.85万吨，与2002年保护初期相比，累计增长40余倍。

chosen.text: Xinhua News Agency, Xining, Dec. 11 (Reporters Luo Xiaofei and Zhang Hongxiang) Reporters learned from the Qinghai Provincial Department of Agriculture and Rural Affairs that the latest monitoring results showed that the reserves of Qinghai Lake nude carp increased by 0.71 million tons this year compared with the previous year, reaching 108,500 tons, and the accumulated increase was more than 40 times compared with the early stage of protection in 2002.

src: 青海湖裸鲤俗名“湟鱼 ” ， 是青海湖中特有的珍贵鱼种，对维系青海湖流域“水-鱼-鸟”生态链安全和生物多样性有着举足轻重的作用。

chosen.text: The naked carp in Qinghai Lake, commonly known as “Huang fish”, is a unique and precious fish species in Qinghai Lake, which plays a crucial role in maintaining the safety of the “water-fish-bird” ecological chain and biodiversity in the Qinghai Lake basin.

src: 20世纪六七十年代，受人为大量捕杀、裸鲤繁殖水域环境日益退化等因素影响，青海湖裸鲤数量锐减，2002年青海湖裸鲤资源蕴藏量仅为2592吨。

chosen.text: In the 1960s and 1970s, due to factors such as massive human hunting and the increasingly degraded environment of the spawning waters, the number of naked carp in Qinghai Lake decreased sharply. In 2002, the resource reserve of naked carp in Qinghai Lake was only 2,592 tons.

src: 2004年在《中国物种红色名录》中青海湖裸鲤被列为濒危物种。

chosen.text: In 2004, the Qinghai Lake naked carp was listed as an endangered species in the Red List of Chinese Species.

src: 从2003年起，青海省实施封湖育鱼，禁止任何单位、集体和个人到青海湖及湖区主要河流及支流捕捞裸鲤，禁止销售裸鲤及其制品。

chosen.text: Since 2003, Qinghai Province has implemented the lake fishery and prohibited any unit, collective and individual to fish for naked carp in Qinghai Lake and the main rivers and tributaries of the lake area, and prohibited the sale of naked carp and its products.

src: 与此同时，通过人工增殖放流以及清理青海湖主要入湖河流河道、设计科学合理的“过鱼通道”等措施持续加大保护力度，青海湖裸鲤资源蕴藏量逐年增加。

chosen.text: Meanwhile, through artificial propagation and release, cleaning up the main rivers of Qinghai Lake, designing scientific and reasonable "fish passage" and other measures to continue to increase protection efforts, the resource reserves of naked carp in Qinghai Lake have increased year by year.

src: 青海省农业农村厅副厅长杨林介绍，截至目前，青海湖裸鲤已累计实施人工增殖放流近1.8亿尾，对青海湖裸鲤资源恢复的贡献率超过23 % 。

chosen.text: Yang Lin, deputy director of Qinghai Provincial Department of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, said that as of now, nearly 180 million naked carp have been released in Qinghai Lake, contributing more than 23% to the recovery of naked carp resources in Qinghai Lake.

src: 青海三江源地区是我国乃至亚洲重要的生态屏障和水源涵养区，而青海湖是控制西部荒漠化向东蔓延的天然屏障和生态功能区。

chosen.text: The Sanjiangyuan region in Qinghai is an important ecological barrier and water conservation area in China and even Asia, while Qinghai Lake is a natural barrier and ecological function area to control the eastward spread of desertification in the west.

src: 为了保护三江源地区和青海湖水域生态环境、保护水生野生动物，维护青藏高原生物多样性，今年以来，青海先后发布长江、黄河、青海湖重点水域禁捕通告，构建起了“一江一河一湖”全面禁捕管理体系。

chosen.text: In order to protect the ecological environment of the Sanjiangyuan region and Qinghai Lake, protect aquatic wildlife, and maintain the biodiversity of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau, Qinghai has successively issued notices on the ban of fishing in key waters of the Yangtze River, Yellow River and Qinghai Lake since this year, and has established a comprehensive management system for the ban of fishing in "one river, one river and one lake".

chosen.text: I would like to express my heartfelt gratitude to all friends for their humanitarian assistance over the long period of more than 30 years after our relatives died, especially since I had issued a call for humanitarian assistance to domestic and foreign friends in my personal name in early 1994, the assistance has not been interrupted so far.

chosen.text: Therefore, I earnestly request you to suspend the humanitarian donation to our group of Tiananmen Mothers, and this humanitarian assistance activity should have been perfectly ended long ago.

chosen.text: Chinese and Saudi curators jointly hold the first contemporary art biennale in Saudi Arabia - Xinhuanet

src: 新华社利雅得12月12日电（记者王海洲 胡冠）沙特阿拉伯首届当代艺术双年展 — — 迪里耶当代艺术双年展，于11日在位于沙特首都利雅得西北部的迪里耶JAX艺术区正式向公众开放，共有来自沙特、中国等地的64位艺术家参展。

chosen.text: Xinhua News Agency, Riyadh, December 12 (Reporters Wang Haizhou and Hu Guan) The first contemporary art biennale in Saudi Arabia - the Diriyah Contemporary Art Biennale was officially opened to the public on the 11th in the Diriyah JAX Art District in the northwest of Riyadh, the capital of Saudi Arabia. A total of 64 artists from Saudi Arabia, China and other places participated in the exhibition.

src: 本次双年展由沙特迪里耶双年展基金会和中国UCCA尤伦斯当代艺术中心联合策划，中国UCCA尤伦斯当代艺术中心馆长田霏宇担任艺术总监。

chosen.text: This biennale was jointly organized by the Saudi Diriyah Biennial Foundation and the UCCA Center for Contemporary Art in China, with Tian Fei-yu, director of the UCCA Center for Contemporary Art in China, serving as artistic director.

src: 据策展团队介绍，本次双年展的主题为“摸着石头过河 ” ， 隐喻社会经济转型时期所采取的改革策略，也反映沙特社会文化发展的当下境遇。

chosen.text: According to the curatorial team, the theme of this biennial is "crossing the river by feeling the stones", which metaphorically refers to the reform strategies adopted during the period of socio-economic transformation and reflects the current situation of Saudi social and cultural development.

src: 本次双年展占地近12000平方米，展厅横跨六个相互连接的建筑，以六个单元呈现 ： 《 摸着石头过河 》 《 传承作为实验 》 《 边缘思考 》 《 走向公众 》 《 美丽新世界》以及《论艺术的精神 》 。

chosen.text: The biennial covers an area of nearly 12,000 square meters, and the exhibition hall spans six interconnected buildings, which are presented in six units: "Crossing the River by Touching Stones", "Inheritance as Experiment", "Thinking at the Edge", "Towards the Public", "A Beautiful New World" and "On the Spirit of Art".

src: 其中，27位沙特艺术家的作品数量占本次展品总量的四成以上，囊括绘画、装置艺术和表演艺术等多种形式；12位中国艺术家的作品同样备受关注，有的艺术家以新颖的方式使用回收材料进行创作，例如徐冰在《背后的故事系列之溪山无尽图 》 （ 2014）中，用废弃物重构了一幅经典山水画。

chosen.text: Among them, the works of 27 Saudi artists account for more than 40% of the total number of exhibits, including painting, installation art and performing arts; the works of 12 Chinese artists are also highly regarded. Some artists use recycled materials in a novel way to create, for example, Xu Bing reconstructed a classic landscape painting with waste in "Behind the Story Series: Endless Mountains and Rivers" (2014).

src: 迪里耶双年展基金会首席执行官巴克利表示，希望本届双年展能够建立国际对话，让全球观众有机会了解沙特蓬勃发展的文化产业和创意社区，加强互动往来。

chosen.text: Buckley, CEO of the Diriyah Biennale Foundation, said that he hoped that this biennale would establish an international dialogue, giving global audiences the opportunity to learn about Saudi Arabia's booming cultural industry and creative community, and strengthen interaction.

src: 田霏宇说 ： “ 双年展的目标是双重的，既能让沙特当代艺术参与全球对话，也能让沙特观众融入当代艺术世界 。 ”

chosen.text: Tian Feiyu said, "The goal of the biennial is twofold. It can not only allow Saudi contemporary art to participate in global dialogue, but also allow Saudi audiences to integrate into the world of contemporary art. "

src: 据了解，在双年展开幕周期间还将举办系列讲座，艺术家、策展人和创意行业的意见领袖将就跨文化交流、当代艺术发展等主题展开讨论。

chosen.text: It is understood that a series of lectures will be held during the opening week of the Biennale, and artists, curators and opinion leaders in creative industries will discuss cross-cultural communication, contemporary art development and other topics.

src: 云南：统筹规范乡村公益性岗位管理-新华网

chosen.text: Yunnan: Coordinate and standardize the management of rural public welfare posts - Xinhuanet

src: 新华社昆明12月12日电（记者林碧锋）为持续做好脱贫人口就业帮扶，巩固拓展脱贫攻坚成果，云南省日前出台促进乡村振兴乡村公益性岗位管理相关政策，助力全面推进乡村振兴。

chosen.text: Xinhua News Agency, Kunming, December 12 (Reporter Lin Bifeng) In order to continue to do a good job in employment assistance for poverty-stricken people and consolidate and expand the achievements of poverty eradication, Yunnan Province recently issued relevant policies on promoting the management of rural public welfare positions to help comprehensively promote rural revitalization.

src: 云南省人社厅有关负责人介绍，目前，云南共开发44.83万个乡村公益性岗位，用于安置脱贫劳动力等农村困难群体就业，在帮助脱贫群众实现就业增收、巩固脱贫攻坚成果、有效提升乡村各项公共服务能力等方面发挥重要作用。

chosen.text: According to the relevant person in charge of the Yunnan Provincial Department of Human Resources and Social Security, at present, Yunnan has developed a total of 448,300 rural public welfare jobs for the employment of poverty-stricken labor force and other rural poor groups, which play an important role in helping the people to achieve employment and income increase, consolidating the achievements of poverty eradication, and effectively improving the rural public service capabilities.

src: 此次新规由云南人社、乡村振兴、财政等七部门联合印发，主要对基层招聘乡村公益性岗位人员的对象范围、资金管理、岗位开发、岗位管理等方面进行统一规范。

chosen.text: The new regulations were jointly issued by seven departments including Yunnan Human Resources and Social Security, Rural Revitalization, and Finance, and mainly unified the scope of recruitment of rural public welfare positions, fund management, position development, and position management.

src: 在岗位开发设置方面，新规明确，按照“按需设岗、以岗定人、动态管理、总量控制 ” “ 谁开发、谁使用、谁负责”及“一人一岗、自愿公开、统一管理”的原则进行设置。

chosen.text: In terms of post development and setting, the new rules clearly state that the posts should be set up in accordance with the principles of "post setting according to needs, determining personnel according to posts, dynamic management, total quantity control", "whoever develops, whoever uses, whoever is responsible" and "one person, one post, voluntary disclosure, unified management".

src: 招聘程序必须按照公告、申报、审核、公示、聘用、岗前培训及安排上岗等步骤进行。

chosen.text: The recruitment process must be carried out in accordance with the announcement, declaration, review, publicity, employment, pre-job training and arrangement for work.

src: 此外，新规还明确了乡村公益性岗位主要开发部门的具体职责、乡村公益性岗位的补贴标准和补贴方式，规定各乡村公益性岗位开发部门应为乡村公益性岗位安置人员购买意外伤害商业保险；要求有关部门定期对乡村公益性岗位补贴发放情况进行监督。

chosen.text: In addition, the new rules also clarify the specific responsibilities of the main development departments for rural public welfare positions, the subsidy standards and methods for rural public welfare positions, and stipulate that each rural public welfare position development department should purchase commercial accident insurance for rural public welfare positions; require relevant departments to regularly supervise the subsidy distribution of rural public welfare positions.

src: 近两年，美帝对华为芯片的封锁和围堵，不仅让华为陷入前所未有的困境，也让“美系”企业遭遇巨大的损失。

chosen.text: In the past two years, the blockade and siege of Huawei chips by the United States have not only put Huawei in an unprecedented predicament, but also caused huge losses to "American" enterprises.

src: 美帝打压中国芯片产业，要求自家企业及盟友国相关企业同时对我国芯片产业进行封锁，直接导致的后果就是全球芯片供应商的订单和利润受到影响，造成芯片生产企业的研发投入降低、产能下降，从而造成了全球范围内芯片供应链的短缺的紊乱。

chosen.text: The US government suppressed China's chip industry, and required its own enterprises and allied countries to blockade China's chip industry at the same time. The direct consequence is that the orders and profits of global chip suppliers were affected, resulting in a reduction in R & D investment and production capacity decline of chip manufacturers, thus causing the shortage and disorder of the global chip supply chain.

src: 如今“缺芯”已经波及到了全球各大行业，比如车企停产、手机涨价，几乎所有用到芯片的行业都深受其害。

chosen.text: Nowadays, “chip shortage” has affected all major industries in the world, such as automobile companies suspending production and mobile phone prices rising. Almost all industries that use chips have been deeply affected.

src: 为了掌握“芯片”自主权，越来越多国家的科技巨头开始走向“去美化”的道路。

chosen.text: In order to master the “chip” autonomy, more and more countries’ technology giants have begun to move towards the path of “de-americanization”.

src: 为了牢牢把控全球半导体控制权，牵制中国半导体行业的发展，最近老美动作频频，又是主持“芯片峰会”；又是邀请64国巨头成立半导体联盟，并拔款扶持美国本土科技巨头，比如，美帝老牌科技巨头英特尔为了夺回在芯片领域的主导地位，斥资200亿美元在美国亚利桑那州建2座晶圆加工厂，并对外开放芯片代工业务。

chosen.text: In order to firmly control the global semiconductor control and restrict the development of China's semiconductor industry, the United States has recently taken frequent actions, such as hosting the "Chip Summit", inviting 64 countries to establish a semiconductor alliance, and allocating funds to support the US local technology giants. For example, in order to regain its leading position in the chip field, the old American technology giant Intel spent $20 billion to build two wafer processing plants in Arizona, USA, and opened up the chip foundry business.

src: 当大多数人都以为，英特尔此番举动将对台积电造成一定冲击，并很有可能抢走台积电的“饭碗”。

chosen.text: When most people thought that Intel's move would have a certain impact on TSMC and was likely to take away TSMC's "rice bowl".

src: 之所以这么肯定，是因为，英特尔作为美帝老牌科技巨头，在半导体领域深耕几十年，拥有大量的人才队伍和技术储备，必定能在短期内迅速崛起，打败台积电。

chosen.text: This is because Intel, as a long-established technology giant of the United States, has been deeply involved in the semiconductor field for decades and has a large number of talent teams and technical reserves, which will surely enable it to rise rapidly in the short term and defeat TSMC.

src: 然而，对于英特尔的这个决定，台积电创始人张忠谋却不屑一顾。

chosen.text: However, for this decision of Intel, TSMC founder Morris Chang is dismissive.

src: 在今年四月举行的“2021大师智库论坛”上，张忠谋语出惊人，对于英特尔斥资建晶圆厂这个举动，张忠谋毫无顾忌直言：英特尔建芯片代工厂，相当讽刺。

chosen.text: At the "2021 Master Think Tank Forum" held in April this year, Morris Chang made a shocking statement. He said without hesitation that Intel's investment in building a wafer factory was quite ironic.

src: 张忠谋之所以对英特尔进军晶圆领域颇为不屑，是因为张忠谋对30多年前台积电与英特尔的一段恩怨依然耿耿于怀。

chosen.text: The reason why Morris Chang is quite disdainful of Intel’s entry into the wafer field is that he still holds a grudge over a grudge between TSMC and Intel more than 30 years ago.

src: 上世纪六七十年代，英特尔一直是美帝制造业中的明珠，雄居全球巅峰的位置，是世界半导体领域的霸主。

chosen.text: In the 1960s and 1970s, Intel has always been a pearl in the manufacturing industry of the United States, occupying the top position in the world, and is the world's semiconductor field hegemon.

src: 到上世纪80年代，世界半导体高端芯片一直被少数强者掌握。

chosen.text: By the 1980s, the world's high-end semiconductor chips had been in the hands of a few powerful companies.

src: 当时半导体行业以IDM模式为特征，芯片从设计、制造到封测都是由一家工厂来完成，英特尔就是那个时代的代表。

chosen.text: At that time, the semiconductor industry was characterized by the IDM model, and the chip was designed, manufactured, and packaged and tested by a single factory. Intel was the representative of that era.

src: 然而这样的模式让一些小企业不堪重负，很多半导体创业者面对巨额的产线建设费用只能望而却步。

chosen.text: However, such a model has overwhelmed some small businesses, and many semiconductor entrepreneurs have been deterred by huge production line construction costs.

src: 在市场需求的感召下，进入80年代后，芯片行业开始出现分工合作的现象，1984年张忠谋听说有专门做芯片设计的公司，便认为既然有专门做设计的，那么就可以成立一家专门用于晶圆制造的工厂。

chosen.text: In the 1980s, inspired by market demand, the chip industry began to see a phenomenon of division of labor and cooperation. In 1984, when Morris Chang heard that there was a company specializing in chip design, he thought that since there was a company specializing in design, then a factory dedicated to wafer manufacturing could be established.

src: 不久之后，张忠谋的设想变成了现实，台积电应运而生。

chosen.text: Not long after, Morris Chang’s vision became a reality, and TSMC was born.

src: 台积电把主营业务瞄准了“晶圆加工”这个单一环节，不进行设计，只提供晶圆制造的代工服务。

chosen.text: TSMC targets its main business on the single link of “wafer processing”, does not carry out design, and only provides foundry services for wafer manufacturing.

src: 当时刚创立的台积电，在英特尔这个巨无霸面前就是小喽啰。

chosen.text: At that time, the newly established TSMC was a small henchman in front of Intel, a giant.

src: 为了获取资本支持，张忠谋就曾找英特尔投资，但当时英特尔一听说台积电只做芯片行业的制造环节，显然有些自视甚高，看不起台积电，果断拒绝对台积电进行投资。

chosen.text: In order to obtain capital support, Zhang Chongmou once sought investment from Intel, but at that time, Intel, after hearing that TSMC only did the manufacturing link of the chip industry, was obviously very arrogant and looked down on TSMC, and resolutely refused to invest in TSMC.

src: 张忠谋也认定英特尔当时是看不起晶圆制程服务的。

chosen.text: Zhang Chongmei also believed that Intel did not respect the wafer process service at that time.

src: 没想到当年看不起晶圆制造服务的巨头，如今却也要开始做晶圆代工。

chosen.text: Unexpectedly, the giants who looked down upon wafer manufacturing services in the past are now also starting to do wafer foundry.

src: 所以，张忠谋觉得英特尔进入晶圆代工很讽刺。

chosen.text: So, Zhang Chongmei thought that Intel’s entry into wafer foundry was very ironic.

src: 如今台积电的市值已经超过了英特尔。

chosen.text: Today, TSMC’s market value has surpassed that of Intel.

src: 面对台积电的强势进攻，英特尔自然也是不敢固步自封。

chosen.text: Faced with TSMC’s aggressive attack, Intel naturally did not dare to stand still.

src: 如今，台积电已经向着3nm芯片冲刺，而英特尔仍然停留在7年前的14nm。

chosen.text: Now, TSMC has rushed towards 3nm chips, while Intel still stays at 14nm seven years ago.

src: 新华社北京12月12日电 综合新华社驻外记者报道：毛里求斯、塞浦路斯和马拉维近日首次报告发现新冠变异病毒奥密克戎毒株感染病例。

chosen.text: Xinhua News Agency, Beijing, December 12 -- According to comprehensive reports from Xinhua News Agency correspondents stationed abroad, Mauritius, Cyprus and Malawi have recently reported the first cases of infection with the Omicron variant of the COVID-19 virus.

src: 毛里求斯10日首次报告该国两例奥密克戎毒株感染病例。

chosen.text: Mauritius reported two cases of Omicron strain infection for the first time on the 10th.

src: 据毛卫生部长凯莱什·贾古特帕尔介绍，一名感染者为自南非出发于11月27日抵达毛里求斯的游客；另一名感染者为毛里求斯本地居民，他与一名近期曾前往南非后返回的人员接触后，于11月30日核酸检测呈阳性。

chosen.text: According to Minister of Health Kailash Jagutpal, one of the infected persons is a tourist who arrived in Mauritius from South Africa on November 27; the other is a local resident of Mauritius, who tested positive for nucleic acid after contact with a person who had recently returned from South Africa.

src: 经医院隔离治疗后，这两名感染者核酸检测结果均转为阴性，目前已返回各自的居住地。

chosen.text: After being treated in isolation at the hospital, the nucleic acid test results of these two infected persons turned negative, and they have now returned to their respective residences.

src: 塞浦路斯卫生部10日宣布该国首次确诊3例奥密克戎毒株感染病例。

chosen.text: Cyprus Health Ministry announced on the 10th that the country had confirmed three cases of Omicron strain infection for the first time.

src: 这3人都是学生，本月初从国外旅行回来，由于均为轻症，并未入院治疗。

chosen.text: All three were students who had returned from a trip abroad earlier this month, and did not require hospitalization as their symptoms were mild.

src: 为防范奥密克戎毒株蔓延，塞政府不断加大防控力度。

chosen.text: In order to prevent the spread of the Omicron strain, the government of Cyprus has continuously increased its prevention and control efforts.

src: 从12月6日到明年1月10日，乘飞机入境的12岁以上旅客抵塞后都需自费在机场接受核酸检测。

chosen.text: From December 6 to January 10 next year, passengers over 12 years old who enter the country by plane will have to pay for nucleic acid testing at the airport after arriving in Serbia.

src: 塞卫生部10日还宣布，将开始为该国5岁至11岁的儿童接种辉瑞新冠疫苗。

chosen.text: The Health Ministry also announced on the 10th that it would begin to vaccinate children aged 5 to 11 in the country with Pfizer COVID-19 vaccine.

src: 马拉维卫生部长昆比泽·奇蓬达9日说，该国首次发现3例奥密克戎毒株感染病例。

chosen.text: Malawi Health Minister Kunbize Chiponda said on the 9th that the country had found three cases of Omicron strain for the first time.

src: 该国卫生部门对从11月9日至12月2日采集的12个新冠阳性样本开展基因组测序，发现了这3例感染病例。

chosen.text: The country's health department carried out genomic sequencing on 12 COVID-19 positive samples collected from November 9 to December 2, and found these three cases of infection.

src: 星空有约丨双子座流星雨14日迎来极大-新华网

chosen.text: Starry Sky Appointment | The Geminid Meteor Shower Will Reach Its Maximum on the 14th - Xinhuanet

src: 新华社天津12月12日电（记者周润健）天文科普专家介绍，作为本年度最后一场大规模流星雨，北半球三大流星雨之一的双子座流星雨将在12月14日迎来极大，喜欢流星雨的朋友可在当日后半夜进行观测。

chosen.text: Xinhua News Agency, Tianjin, December 12 (Reporter Zhou Runjian) According to astronomy popularization experts, as the last large-scale meteor shower of the year, the Geminid meteor shower, one of the three major meteor showers in the Northern Hemisphere, will reach its peak on December 14. Friends who like meteor showers can observe it in the latter half of the day.

src: 北京市天文爱好者安久2018年12月13日在青海拍摄的双子座流星雨。

chosen.text: A double star meteor shower photographed by Beijing astronomy enthusiast An Jiu in Qinghai on December 13, 2018.

src: 大部分流星雨的母天体都是周期彗星，但双子座流星雨的母天体却是3200号小行星法厄同，这是一颗阿波罗型小行星。

chosen.text: Most meteor showers are caused by periodic comets, but the parent body of the Geminid meteor shower is the asteroid 3200 Phaethon, an Apollo asteroid.

src: 双子座流星雨也是目前已知第二个不是由彗星“孕育”的流星雨。

chosen.text: The Geminid meteor shower is also the second known meteor shower that is not "born" from a comet.

src: 天津市天文学会理事、天文科普专家修立鹏介绍说，就如贺岁大片一样，双子座流星雨一般在岁末出现 ， “ 上映档期”可以从12月4日持续到17日。

chosen.text: Xiu Lipeng, a council member of Tianjin Astronomical Society and an astronomy popularization expert, said that just like the New Year’s blockbuster, the Geminid meteor shower generally appears at the end of the year, and its “release period” can last from December 4 to 17.

src: 该流星雨以流量大且稳定著称，与象限仪流星雨、英仙座流星雨一起被称为北半球三大流星雨。

chosen.text: This meteor shower is known for its large and stable flow, and together with Quadrantid meteor shower and Perseid meteor shower, it is called the three major meteor showers in the Northern Hemisphere.

src: 双子座流星雨的一个显著特点是流星体速度较慢，色彩丰富，火流星也不少，既适合目视，也适合天文摄影的初学者进行拍摄。

chosen.text: A remarkable feature of the Geminid meteor shower is that the meteoroids are slow, colorful, and fireballs are not uncommon, which is suitable for both visual observation and astronomy photography for beginners.

src: 天津市天文爱好者杨婧2020年12月13日在天津蓟州拍摄的双子座流星雨。

chosen.text: A Geminid meteor shower photographed by Yang Jing, an astronomy enthusiast in Tianjin, on December 13, 2020, in Jizhou, Tianjin.

src: 天文预报显示，今年的双子座流星雨将于12月14日15时左右迎来极大，极大时ZHR（在理想观测条件下，辐射点位于头顶正上方时，每小时能看到的流星数量）为150。

chosen.text: According to the astronomical forecast, the Geminid meteor shower this year will reach its peak at about 15:00 on December 14, and the ZHR (the number of meteors that can be seen per hour when the radiant point is directly above the head under ideal observation conditions) will be 150.

src: 双子座流星雨推荐指数图。

chosen.text: The recommended index map of Geminid meteor shower.

src: “去年 ， ‘ 落英缤纷’的双子座流星雨给人们留下了深刻印象，但今年的双子座流星雨会受到月光干扰，精彩程度会打一点折扣。

chosen.text: “Last year, the ‘fallen flowers’ Geminid meteor shower left a deep impression on people, but this year’s Geminid meteor shower will be affected by moonlight, and the wonderfulness will be discounted.

src: 14日为农历十一月十一，月相为盈凸月，明亮的月光会对观测造成干扰，好在后半夜月亮就会落下，此时双子座流星雨的辐射点也会升得比较高。

chosen.text: The 14th is November 11 of the lunar calendar, and the phase of the moon is a full gibbous moon. The bright moonlight will interfere with observations. Fortunately, the moon will set in the second half of the night, and at this time, the radiant point of the Geminid meteor shower will also rise relatively high.

src: 喜欢流星雨的朋友可在后半夜月落后的这几个小时进行观测，但要注意防寒保暖 。 ”

chosen.text: Friends who like meteor showers can observe in the next few hours after the moon sets in the middle of the night, but they should pay attention to keeping warm. "

src: 如何才能尽可能地观测到更多的流星呢？

chosen.text: How can we see as many meteors as possible?

src: “不建议在城市进行观测，可以在郊区或是乡村选择一个海拔高、光害小、面向东北方向的视野开阔之处，然后耐心地等到月亮落下后，目视观测即可。

chosen.text: "It is not recommended to observe in the city, you can choose a high altitude, low light pollution and open view in the northeast direction in the suburbs or countryside, and then wait patiently until the moon falls, and then observe with the naked eye.

src: 需要注意的是，双子座流星雨朝各个方向的流量都很大，观测时不用一直盯着双子座流星雨的辐射点看。

chosen.text: It should be noted that the Geminid meteor shower has a large flow in all directions, so there is no need to keep staring at the radiant point of the Geminid meteor shower during observation.

src: 喜欢摄影的朋友要想拍摄出绚丽的‘流星雨大片 ’ ， 最好选择广角、大光圈的镜头，拍摄时使用高ISO和最大光圈。

chosen.text: Friends who like photography should choose a wide-angle, large aperture lens to shoot a gorgeous'meteor shower', and use high ISO and maximum aperture when shooting.

src: 基于稳定性和持续性考虑，三脚架、备用电池和快门线也必不可少 。 ”

chosen.text: Based on stability and sustainability, tripods, spare batteries and shutter release cables are also essential. "

src: 之所以在大屏市场有如此好的成绩，主要归功于激光电视在护眼方面的出色表现。

chosen.text: The reason for such good performance in the large screen market is mainly due to the excellent performance of laser TVs in terms of eye protection.

src: 基于激光电视漫反射的成像原理，激光光源发出的光线并不直射入眼球，相比液晶电视的背光源发光，成像过程更接近自然条件下物体的成像过程，对眼睛产生的刺激也更小。

chosen.text: Based on the imaging principle of diffuse reflection of laser TV, the light emitted by the laser light source does not directly enter the eye. Compared with the backlight of liquid crystal TV, the imaging process is closer to the imaging process of objects under natural conditions, and the stimulus to the eyes is also smaller.

src: 中国电子技术标准化研究院赛西实验室和北京协和医院眼科专家，通过人群相同条件下观看激光电视和液晶电视的严格对比试验，得出了144组测试数据。

chosen.text: The China Electronics Standardization Institute’s Sai Xi Laboratory and Beijing Union Medical College Hospital’s ophthalmology experts obtained 144 sets of test data through strict comparative experiments under the same conditions for watching laser TVs and LCD TVs.

src: 数据证实：激光电视的确具有很强的护眼特性，在特定方面甚至具有一定的改善作用。

chosen.text: The data confirms that laser TVs do have strong eye protection characteristics, and even have a certain improvement effect in specific aspects.

src: 在视力健康越来越受重视的当下，激光电视不仅凭借护眼优势吸引了越来越多用户，也打开了彩电市场的另一个突破口。

chosen.text: In the current situation where visual health is receiving increasing attention, laser TVs have not only attracted more and more users with their eye protection advantages, but also opened another breakthrough in the color TV market.

src: 第二，激光电视更聚焦高端市场。

chosen.text: Second, laser TVs are more focused on high-end markets.

src: 与液晶电视价格不断下探相反，目前市售激光电视的价格大多在万元以上，随着尺寸和光源的升级，价格逐步攀升。

chosen.text: In contrast to the continuous decline in the price of LCD TVs, the current market price of laser TVs is mostly above 10,000 yuan, and the price gradually climbs with the upgrade of size and light source.

src: 激光电视凭什么卖这么贵呢？

chosen.text: Why is the laser TV so expensive?

src: 肯定是有道理的。

chosen.text: It's definitely a valid point.

src: 在光源和技术水平的不断发展下，激光电视有很多液晶电视和投影都无法实现的优势。

chosen.text: With the continuous development of light source and technology, laser TV has many advantages that cannot be achieved by LCD TVs and projectors.

src: 凭借超短焦距投影技术，激光电视的投影距离相对传统投影设备来说要更短，能够在短距离内实现100英寸大屏体验，所需空间不大，而且主机小巧，占用地方很小。

chosen.text: With ultra-short focal length projection technology, the projection distance of laser TV is shorter than that of traditional projection equipment, which can achieve a 100-inch large screen experience in a short distance, requires little space, and the main unit is small and occupies very little space.

src: 在亮度方面，大品牌激光电视可以达到2000以上的流明。

chosen.text: In terms of brightness, big brand laser TVs can reach more than 2000 lumens.

src: 加之发热量更低，对设备损耗小，电视的使用寿命也更长。

chosen.text: In addition, the calorific value is lower, the equipment loss is small, and the service life of the TV is longer.

src: 除此之外，很多高端激光电视机型还搭载了真4K超高清画质、人工智能系统、仿生屏等众多前沿技术，能够给用户带来更震撼的视听体验。

chosen.text: In addition, many high-end laser TV models are equipped with true 4K ultra-high definition, artificial intelligence system, bionic screen and many other cutting-edge technologies, which can bring users a more shocking audio-visual experience.

src: 谈不上伪需求，而是需求细分的产物，论画质和投入产出比，激光电视不是影音玩家的菜，想兼顾大屏和观看环境不足，可以尝试，凡事皆有利弊，权衡过后自己判断即可，就怕听信一面之词。

chosen.text: It is not a false demand, but a product of demand segmentation. In terms of picture quality and input-output ratio, laser TV is not a good choice for audiovisual players. If you want to balance large screen and insufficient viewing environment, you can try it. Everything has its advantages and disadvantages. You can make your own judgment after weighing. I am afraid that you will believe one-sided words.

src: 简单说，超广角近焦投影机--激光电视，为了贴近幕布，不得不使用价格昂贵的超广角透镜和反射镜，这不符合光学最佳设计。

chosen.text: In short, ultra-wide-angle near-focusing projectors - laser TVs, in order to get close to the screen, have to use expensive ultra-wide-angle lenses and mirrors, which does not conform to the best optical design.

src: 为了屏蔽部分环境光，使用微结构的菲涅尔幕布，代价高昂，80寸的价格基本能换个65寸液晶。

chosen.text: In order to block some ambient light, the use of micro-structured Fresnel curtains is costly, and the price of 80 inches can basically be exchanged for a 65-inch LCD.

src: 还有一点，我特别讨厌投影厂商拿漫反射对眼睛好这种当卖点，拜托，眼睛能够看到的幕布上的光线对于眼睛而言就是直射光，你漫反射到天花板上，眼睛也看不到，非要较真液晶电视也是漫“直射”，打开电视天花板不也被照亮吗？

chosen.text: One more thing, I really hate that projection manufacturers use the argument that diffused light is good for eyes as a selling point. Please, the light on the screen that our eyes can see is direct light. If you diffuse it to the ceiling, our eyes cannot see it. You can’t argue that LCD TVs are also diffused “direct light”. When you turn on the TV, the ceiling will be lit up, right?

src: 而且，投影幕布如果不是漫反射，根本成不了像。

chosen.text: Moreover, if the projection screen is not diffused reflection, it cannot form an image.

src: 恰恰被忽略了高增益幕布的热斑（光斑）效应，某一角度大量光线反射到眼睛，那才是真难受。

chosen.text: It is precisely the hot spot (spot) effect of the high-gain screen that has been ignored. A large amount of light is reflected to the eyes at a certain angle, and that is really uncomfortable.

src: 从设置条件来看：按照《保险经纪机构监管规定(2015年修订)》提示来看，成为保险经纪公司的，必须满足三个关键词：股东、发起人最近3年无重大违法记录、最低限额为人民币5000万元才可以成立、必须经过中国保监会同意。

chosen.text: From the perspective of setting conditions, according to the "Regulations on the Supervision of Insurance Brokerage Institutions (Revised in 2015)", to become an insurance brokerage company, three key words must be met: shareholders and promoters have no major illegal records in the past three years, the minimum limit is RMB50 million, and it must be approved by the China Insurance Regulatory Commission.

src: 这三条其实就是很苛刻的，总结起来就是要有实力，要经过银保监会（监管全国内的保险公司、银行）的国家权威部门批准、股东要有良好的作风，作为保险经纪公司的小雨伞保险，投保者是不用过多质疑小雨伞保险是正规的与否，毕竟有这3条门槛，不是什么保险公司都能达到的。

chosen.text: These three requirements are actually very strict. In summary, they require that you have the ability, and be approved by the national authority of the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission (CBIRC), which oversees all insurance companies and banks in China, shareholders must have good conduct, and as an insurance brokerage company, Little Umbrella Insurance, policyholders do not need to question whether Little Umbrella Insurance is legitimate or not, after all, these three thresholds are not something any insurance company can meet.

src: 在这一点上，还不错，是值得信赖的。

chosen.text: It's good at this point, it's reliable.

chosen.text: From the perspective of insurance products, Xiaoyuanshu Insurance is an insurance supermarket, and many companies’ star critical illness insurance are sold on this platform, such as the latest He Tai Super Mary No. 5 Critical Illness Insurance, where the claim settlement party and the underwriter are both He Tai Life Insurance, and Xiaoyuanshu Insurance is just a third-party intermediary, so there is no need to question its reliability.

src: 从缴费模式来看：互联网平台的产品，因为少了营业网点的经营费用，和业务员工资的成本，所以互联网产品普遍性价比比较高，而且缴费方式灵活，支持月缴，减轻投保人的缴费压力，同时可以最大限度的撬动保险的杠杆。

chosen.text: From the perspective of payment mode, the products of Internet platforms have a relatively high cost performance because they have less operating expenses and business staff salary costs. Moreover, the payment method is flexible, supporting monthly payment, reducing the payment pressure of the policyholder, and at the same time, it can maximize the leverage of insurance.

src: 这点还是非常不错的。

chosen.text: That's very good.

src: 可以考虑。

src: 从业务员专业度来看：这点尤为重要，因为保险是一个专业度要求非常强的行业，很多互联网产品客户可以自己投保，这种就会存在很多的误区，在健康告知和职业这块，非保险从业人员往往在投保的时候会添加自己的主观意识，觉得自己健康或者符合，这样容易存在很多理赔隐患，有可能被拒赔的风险。

src: 越南人民报网 - 越南政府总理范明正出席第三次越南国家数字技术企业发展论坛

chosen.text: Vietnam News Online - Vietnamese Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh attended the Third Vietnam National Digital Technology Enterprise Development Forum

src: 第三次越南国家数字技术企业发展论坛期间举行两场主要会议，讨论议题围绕着数字技术企业与国家数字化转型、数字技术企业与新冠肺炎疫情中和疫情后经济复苏与发展两大主题。

chosen.text: During the Third Vietnam National Digital Technology Enterprise Development Forum, two main conferences were held, and the topics discussed revolved around the two major themes of digital technology enterprises and national digital transformation, and digital technology enterprises and economic recovery and development during and after the COVID-19 pandemic.

src: 通信传媒部部长阮孟雄表示，2021年，尽管新冠肺炎疫情持续蔓延，但越南数字技术企业的数量和营业收入仍保持增长势头，达近10 % 。

chosen.text: According to Nguyen Meng Hung, Minister of Communications and Media, in 2021, despite the continued spread of COVID-19, the number and operating income of Vietnamese digital technology companies still maintained a growth momentum, reaching nearly 10%.

src: 2021年，越南典型数字产品数量耕作，集中解决越南面临的各大难题，许多数字产品已走出国门，越南数字技术排名已提升。

chosen.text: In 2021, a number of typical digital products were cultivated in Vietnam, which focused on solving major problems faced by Vietnam. Many digital products have gone abroad, and Vietnam's digital technology ranking has been improved.

src: 阮孟雄部长呼吁数字技术企业负起发展国家数字化转型平台的责任，担当发展这些国家数字平台的任务就是担当国家使命。

chosen.text: Minister Ruan Mengxiong called on digital technology companies to take responsibility for developing the country's digital transformation platform, and taking on the task of developing these national digital platforms is a national mission.

src: 在论坛上，各部门和国家机关领导，正在研究、发展、应用、转让数字技术的企业、组织和个人分享了动员和汇集全社会资源来发展越南技术企业，携手推动国家数字化转型，朱慧疫情后经济复苏等的各突破性设想和解决方案。

chosen.text: At the forum, leaders of various departments and state organs, enterprises, organizations, and individuals that are researching, developing, applying, and transferring digital technologies shared their breakthrough ideas and solutions for mobilizing and pooling resources from all sectors of society to develop Vietnamese technology enterprises, jointly promote national digital transformation, and revive the economy after the epidemic.

src: 范明正总理在论坛上发表讲话时强调，数字化转型是世界必由之路，是发展的客观需求。

chosen.text: In his speech at the forum, Prime Minister Fan Mingzheng stressed that digital transformation is the only way for the world and an objective requirement for development.

src: 数字化转型已成为全球性问题，数字化转型服务全民，因此需动员全民参与。

chosen.text: Digital transformation has become a global issue, and digital transformation services are for all, so it is necessary to mobilize the whole nation to participate.

src: 人民和企业是数字化转型的核心、主体、目标和动力。

chosen.text: People and enterprises are the core, main body, goal and driving force of digital transformation.

src: 因此，一切政策需为了人民和企业。

chosen.text: Therefore, all policies should be for the people and enterprises.

src: 范明正总理强调，数字化转型需体现民族精神，需以内力为主、战略、长期和决定性因素，外力为重要和突破口。

chosen.text: Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh stressed that digital transformation should reflect national spirit, and should be based on internal forces, strategic, long-term and decisive factors, while external forces are important and breakthrough points.

src: 他同时认为，数字化转型需驱动向纵深发展和可持续发展，参与新冠肺炎疫情防控、经济复苏和发展、应对其后变化、克服自然资源枯竭现象，助力绿色转型、发展绿色能源。

chosen.text: He also believed that digital transformation should drive in-depth and sustainable development, participate in the prevention and control of COVID-19, economic recovery and development, respond to subsequent changes, overcome the phenomenon of natural resource depletion, help with green transformation, and develop green energy.

src: 数字化转型需参与保护和弘扬有关国家文化价值、历史传统、国家风土人情等的数据库建立工作，推动银行、税务、土地管理和开发数据库以及物流等领域数字化转型。

chosen.text: The digital transformation requires participation in the establishment of databases related to national cultural values, historical traditions, national customs and practices, etc., and promotes the digital transformation of banks, taxation, land management and development databases, and logistics.

src: 数字化转型的最大目标是让人民更幸福，国家日益繁荣发展。

chosen.text: The biggest goal of digital transformation is to make people happier and the country more prosperous.

src: 范明正总理要求各级政府、各级机关和企业在发展数字技术中需加大领导和指导力度，提高对数字化转型的认识，继续制定和完善关于数字化转型的体制，加强国家管理度和本着尊重、沟通、倾听、积极和主动的精神上推动对数字技术企业发展。

chosen.text: Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh asked governments at all levels, government agencies and enterprises to strengthen leadership and guidance in the development of digital technology, raise awareness of digital transformation, continue to formulate and improve the system for digital transformation, strengthen national management, and promote the development of digital technology enterprises with a spirit of respect, communication, listening, and initiative.

src: 论坛期间，范明正总理出席了2021年“越南制造”优秀数字产品奖颁奖仪式及“越南制造”数字产品展开幕式。

chosen.text: During the forum, Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh attended the award ceremony of 2021 "Made in Vietnam" Excellent Digital Products Award and the opening ceremony of "Made in Vietnam" Digital Products Exhibition.

src: 长江干流实现水上绿色综合服务区全覆盖-新华网

chosen.text: The Yangtze River has achieved full coverage of green comprehensive service areas on water - Xinhuanet

src: 新华社武汉12月11日电（记者王贤）重庆市涪陵水上绿色综合服务区10日如期建成投入运营，这是继8日四川省泸州水上绿色综合服务区挂牌运营后，长江上游正式运营的第2个水上绿色综合服务区。

chosen.text: Xinhua News Agency, Wuhan, December 11 (Reporter Wang Xian) The Fuling Water Green Comprehensive Service Area in Chongqing was completed and put into operation on schedule on the 10th. This is the second water green comprehensive service area officially operating in the upper reaches of the Yangtze River after the Luzhou Water Green Comprehensive Service Area in Sichuan Province was put into operation on the 8th.

src: 至此，水上绿色综合服务区已覆盖长江上、中、下游。

chosen.text: So far, the green comprehensive service area has covered the upper, middle and lower reaches of the Yangtze River.

src: 交通运输部长江航务管理局副局长邱健华介绍说，此前，湖北、湖南、江西、安徽、江苏等省份已在长江中游、下游建成运行10个水上绿色综合服务区，得到了广大船员的认可，为推进长江航运高质量发展发挥了重要作用。

chosen.text: Qiu Jianhua, deputy director of the Yangtze River Shipping Administration Bureau of the Ministry of Transport, said that previously, Hubei, Hunan, Jiangxi, Anhui, Jiangsu and other provinces have built and operated 10 water-based green integrated service areas in the middle and lower reaches of the Yangtze River, which have been recognized by the majority of sailors and played an important role in promoting the high-quality development of Yangtze River shipping.

src: 水上绿色综合服务区全覆盖是长江绿色航运建设的又一里程碑事件，长江船舶污染物接收、航运服务能力得到显著提升。

chosen.text: The full coverage of green comprehensive service areas on water is another milestone event in the construction of green shipping on the Yangtze River, and the reception of ship pollutants and shipping services on the Yangtze River have been significantly improved.

src: 据介绍，水上绿色综合服务区是为广大船舶、船员提供全方位生产、生活服务，帮助广大船员解决“急难愁盼”问题的重要设施。

chosen.text: According to the introduction, the water green comprehensive service area is an important facility that provides all-round production and living services for ships and crew, and helps crew solve the problems of "urgency, difficulty, anxiety and expectation".

src: 此次建成运行的长江上游两处水上绿色综合服务区，集生活服务、生产服务和政务服务为一体，以绿色环保为主题，以船舶维修与船舶应急救援服务为特色，实现港内船舶“一次靠泊、多项服务 ” ， 将使得常年航行在长江的船员工作更高效、生活更便捷。

chosen.text: The two water-based green comprehensive service areas in the upper reaches of the Yangtze River, which have been completed and put into operation this time, integrate living services, production services and government services, take green environmental protection as the theme, take ship maintenance and ship emergency rescue services as the characteristics, realize "one-time berthing, multiple services" for ships in the port, and will make the work of crew members who sail on the Yangtze River more efficient and their life more convenient.

src: 美三航母集结中国周边 最强大武器罕见访问关岛 2022-01-17 多维 亲中共媒体多维报道：中美关系最新消息：最新卫星图像显示，美国三艘航母正在中国周边集结；美媒还披露，美国海军武器库中最强大的武器之一罕见访问关岛，对印太地区美国的盟友与敌手释放重要信号。

chosen.text: Three US aircraft carriers assembled around China, and the most powerful weapon visited Guam rarely. 2022-01-17 Multi-dimensional. The pro-China media reported in multiple dimensions: The latest news of Sino-US relations: The latest satellite images show that three US aircraft carriers are assembling around China; the US media also revealed that one of the most powerful weapons in the US Navy's arsenal visited Guam rarely, sending an important signal to the allies and enemies of the United States in the Indo-Pacific region.

src: 据中国智库“南海战略态势感知平台”消息，1月9日，卫星在巴拉巴克海峡附近发现了美军“卡尔·文森”号（USS Carl Vinson）航母。

chosen.text: According to the news of the South China Sea Strategic Situation Awareness Platform, a Chinese think tank, on January 9, the satellite found the US aircraft carrier USS Carl Vinson near the Palawan Strait.

src: 巴拉巴克海峡连通南海和苏禄海，是西太平洋第一岛链上的战略要地。

chosen.text: The Babalak Strait connects the South China Sea and the Sulu Sea, and is a strategic location on the first island chain of the Western Pacific Ocean.

src: 该平台预计，“卡尔·文森”号将前往南海部署。

chosen.text: The platform predicted that the USS Carl Vinson would be deployed to the South China Sea.

src: 这是“卡尔·文森”号航母首次搭载F-35C战斗机和CMV-22“鱼鹰”舰载运输机进行部署。

chosen.text: This is the first time that the "Carl Vinson" aircraft carrier has been deployed with F-35C fighter jets and CMV-22 "Osprey" shipborne transport aircraft.

src: 现在正在太平洋上游弋的美军航母，除了“卡尔·文森”号外，还有1月3日从美国出发的“亚伯拉罕·林肯”号（USS Abraham Lincoln）航母。

chosen.text: The US aircraft carriers currently cruising in the Pacific Ocean, besides the USS Carl Vinson, also include the USS Abraham Lincoln which set off from the United States on January 3.

src: “林肯”号也首次搭载了F-35C舰载机中队，该中队隶属美国海军陆战队的第314战斗机攻击中队。

chosen.text: The USS Lincoln also carried the F-35C carrier-based aircraft squadron for the first time, which is affiliated with the 314th Fighter Attack Squadron of the US Marine Corps.

src: 除了上述两艘航母外，目前美国海军部署在亚太地区的还有停靠在日本横须贺的“里根”号（USS Ronald Reagan）航母。

chosen.text: In addition to the above two aircraft carriers, the US Navy has deployed the USS Ronald Reagan aircraft carrier in Yokosuka, Japan.

src: 航母战斗群中还包括“尚普兰湖”号导弹巡洋舰、“斯托克达尔”号导弹驱逐舰等。

chosen.text: The aircraft carrier battle group also includes Lake Champlain missile cruiser, Stockdale missile destroyer, etc.

src: 美三航母集结中国周边 最强大武器罕见访问关岛 2022年1月17日，“南海战略态势感知平台”公布最新卫星图片，显示美军三艘航母正在中国周边集结。

chosen.text: The US has assembled three aircraft carriers around China, and its most powerful weapon visited Guam. On January 17, 2022, the "South China Sea Strategic Situation Awareness Platform" released the latest satellite images, showing that the US military had assembled three aircraft carriers around China.

src: （微博@南海战略态势感知） 美三航母集结中国周边 最强大武器罕见访问关岛 2022年1月17日，美军舰载运输机CMV-22B飞行路线。

chosen.text: (Weibo @South China Sea Strategic Situation Awareness) The three US aircraft carriers gathered around China, and the most powerful weapon made a rare visit to Guam. On January 17, 2022, the flight route of the US carrier-based transport CMV-22B.

src: （微博@南海战略态势感知） 另据美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）1月17日报道，美国海军武器库中最强大的武器之一上周末罕见地访问了关岛。

chosen.text: (Weibo @South China Sea Strategic Situation Awareness) According to CNN on January 17, one of the most powerful weapons in the US Navy arsenal visited Guam for the first time last weekend.

src: 载有20枚三叉戟（Trident）弹道导弹和数十枚核弹头的俄亥俄级核潜艇“内华达号”（USS Nevada）上周六（1月15日）驶入美国关岛海军基地。

chosen.text: The USS Nevada, a nuclear-powered Ohio-class submarine carrying 20 Trident ballistic missiles and dozens of nuclear warheads, sailed into the US naval base in Guam on Saturday (January 15).

src: 美三航母集结中国周边 最强大武器罕见访问关岛 分析称，这是向印度-太平洋地区日益紧张的局势中的盟友和敌人发出了一个信号。

chosen.text: The three US aircraft carriers gathered around China, and the most powerful weapon made a rare visit to Guam. According to analysts, this is a signal sent to allies and enemies in the increasingly tense situation in the Indian-Pacific region.

src: 这是美国弹道导弹潜艇自2016年以来首次访问关岛，也是自20世纪80年代以来第二次公开访问关岛。

chosen.text: This is the first time that a U.S. ballistic missile submarine has visited Guam since 2016, and it is the second time that it has been publicly visited since the 1980s.

src: 美三航母集结中国周边 最强大武器罕见访问关岛 中国近年来在南沙群岛修建大批军事设施。

chosen.text: The three US aircraft carriers gathered around China, and the most powerful weapon visited Guam. In recent years, China has built a large number of military facilities in the Nansha Islands.

src: 图为中国在南沙群岛的永暑岛。

chosen.text: The picture shows Yongshu Island in the Nansha Islands.

src: （南海研究论坛） 美国海军在声明中称，俄亥俄级核潜艇“内华达号”此次对关岛的访问加强了美国和该地区盟友之间的合作，展示了美国的能力、灵活性、战备状态，以及对印太地区安全与稳定的持续承诺。

chosen.text: (The South China Sea Research Forum) The US Navy said in a statement that the Ohio-class nuclear submarine "Nevada" strengthened the cooperation between the United States and its allies in the region, demonstrated the capabilities, flexibility, combat readiness, and continued commitment to security and stability in the Indo-Pacific region.

src: 弹道导弹潜艇通常被称为“雷鸣潜艇”（Boomer submarine）。

chosen.text: Ballistic missile submarines are commonly referred to as "Boomer" submarines.

src: 美国海军舰队中14艘“雷鸣潜艇”的行踪通常是被严格保密的。

chosen.text: The whereabouts of 14 of the U.S. Navy's "Thresher submarines" are usually kept strictly confidential.

src: 围绕着弹道导弹潜艇的秘密使“雷鸣潜艇”成为“核三位一体中最重要的生存武器”，这一体系还包括位于美国本土的发射井弹道导弹，以及B-2和B-52等可携带核弹头的轰炸机。

chosen.text: The secret of ballistic missile submarines makes the "Thresher submarine" the "most important survival weapon in the nuclear triad", which also includes the launch shaft ballistic missiles located in the United States, and the B-2 and B-52 bombers that can carry nuclear warheads.

src: 跟朋友聊起最近Meta大跌 26%，市值蒸发 2510 亿美元，扎克伯格回应「面临前所未有的竞争」，原因为何？

chosen.text: When I told a friend about Meta's recent 26% drop, a $251 billion evaporation, Zuckerberg responded that he was "facing unprecedented competition." Why?

src: Meta（原 Facebook）实质是一家广告公司，收入主要来自于广告，今时今日赚钱的广告公司，自己是有流量渠道的。

chosen.text: Meta (formerly Facebook) is essentially an advertising company, and its income mainly comes from advertising. Advertising companies that make money today have their own traffic channels.

src: Facebook，Instagram，Whatsapp 等等，无论什么样的功能定位，都是 Meta 的流量渠道。

chosen.text: Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and so on, whatever their feature orientation, are Meta's traffic channels.

src: 不仅如此，Meta 还是最大的”广告联盟”,很多 App 外接 Meta 的广告，通过 Meta 的广告平台是实现变现。

chosen.text: Moreover, Meta is also the largest “ad alliance”. Many apps connect to Meta’s ads and monetize through Meta’s ad platform.

src: 但是，时代变了。

chosen.text: But times have changed.

src: 第一，因为苹果隐私政策的调整，Meta 很难再拿到用户的数据信息，影响了广告投放的效率。

chosen.text: First, because of the adjustment of Apple's privacy policy, Meta has difficulty in getting user data information, which affects the efficiency of advertising placement.

src: 苹果现在的隐私政策对用户很友好，会很明显的提示用户是否允许 App 获取自己的信息，大多数人的正常反应肯定是不允许。

chosen.text: Apple's current privacy policy is user-friendly, and it will clearly prompt users whether they allow the app to get their information, and most people's normal reaction is definitely not to allow.

src: 接下来如果 Google 再捅一刀，对 Meta 的收入影响还会更大。

chosen.text: If Google were to take another hit, it would have a bigger impact on Meta's revenue.

src: 第二，以前 Meta 的收入增长里的中国因素也弱化了（这个因素的比重不确定有多高，但确实存在）。

chosen.text: Second, the China factor in Meta’s revenue growth has also weakened (the proportion of this factor is uncertain how high, but it does exist).

src: 大家平时都知道 Meta 在中国是没有业务的，但是这个理解并不准确。

chosen.text: Everyone knows that Meta has no business in China, but this understanding is not accurate.

src: 每年 Meta 至少10%的收入都来自中国，主要是中国做出海业务的公司贡献的。

chosen.text: At least 10% of Meta’s revenue comes from China every year, mainly contributed by companies that have gone overseas.

src: Meta 在香港的办公室大概几百人，在大陆还有几大代理商。

chosen.text: Meta has about a few hundred people in its Hong Kong office, and several major agents on the mainland.

src: 中国公司想要拓展海外市场，Meta 都是绕不过的广告渠道，烧的钱大多都给了 Meta。

chosen.text: Meta is an advertising channel that Chinese companies cannot bypass if they want to expand overseas markets, and most of the money burned was given to Meta.

src: 有意思的是，现在字节的 TT 是 Meta 主要的竞争对手之一，但是前两年 Meta 从字节身上可赚到不少钱。

chosen.text: Interestingly, Byte's TT is now one of Meta's main competitors, but Meta made a lot of money from Byte in the past two years.

src: 国内各个代理都在帮字节去 Meta 那里投广告，Meta 大中华区的业绩也很不错。

chosen.text: All domestic agents are helping ByteDance to place advertisements on Meta, and Meta’s performance in Greater China is also very good.

src: 最近我没有专门去了解，但是肯定不会比之前好。

chosen.text: I haven't looked at it recently, but I'm sure it's not any better than before.

src: 中国公司在海外大规模烧钱的阶段已经过去了。

chosen.text: The stage of Chinese companies burning money overseas on a large scale has passed.

src: 第三，新的流量渠道拓展不顺利。

chosen.text: Third, new traffic channels are not expanding smoothly.

src: Facebook 越来越老了，新的包括 TT 在内的平台，都不在 Meta 手中。

chosen.text: Facebook is getting old, and new platforms including TT are not in Meta's hands.

src: 最大的问题不仅仅是收入下滑，而是缺乏增长预期。

chosen.text: The biggest problem is not just the decline in income, but the lack of growth expectations.

src: 资本市场不仅仅看中收入，更重要的是看未来的预期怎么样。

chosen.text: The capital market is not only concerned with income, but more importantly, it looks at how the future expectations are.

src: 很显然，Meta 的预期是不够的。

chosen.text: It's clear Meta's expectations weren't enough.

src: 为了给市场讲出新的故事，扎克伯格讲了 “元宇宙”.

chosen.text: In order to tell a new story for the market, Zuckerberg talked about "metaverse".

src: 元宇宙确实应该是未来的方向之一，但是元宇宙的实现周期比较长，这个故事在这两三年应该不足以支撑起 Meta 的市值。

chosen.text: The metaverse is indeed one of the future directions, but the implementation cycle of the metaverse is relatively long, and this story should not be enough to support Meta’s market value in the next two or three years.

src: 所以未来这两年，应该是 Meta 比较艰难的时期。

chosen.text: So, the next two years should be a tough time for Meta.

src: 别看脸书现在非常的风光，每年也有1,000亿到2,000亿美元的收入，实际上脸书现在危机感非常强，跟其他的互联网企业和高科技公司相比，没有什么好的安全的护城河。

chosen.text: Although Facebook is very prosperous now and has an annual income of $100 billion to $200 billion, in fact, Facebook is now very crisis-stricken. Compared with other Internet companies and high-tech companies, it has no good and safe moat.

src: 虽然他的几款社交软件现在的日活比较高，也是主流的社交软件，比如Facebook，WhatsApp等等，但是面对tiktok的快速发展，脸书也没有什么信心，颠覆之间也就是眨眼的功夫。

chosen.text: Although his several social software now have high daily activity and are mainstream social software, such as Facebook, WhatsApp, etc., Facebook has no confidence in the face of the rapid development of TikTok. The subversion is just a blink of an eye.

src: 而搞元宇宙这个可望而不可及的概念，短时间之内完全没有成功的希望，因此脸书非常的危险，这也是为什么扎克伯格又是换公司的名字，又是不停的寻找新的赛道的根本原因，但是我觉得他的赛道选择是错的，是一条不归路 以上是我的一些思考，供参考。

chosen.text: The concept of metaverse is out of reach, and there is no hope of success in a short time. Therefore, Facebook is very dangerous. This is also the fundamental reason why Zuckerberg changed the company name and kept looking for new tracks. However, I think his track selection is wrong, and it is a dead end. The above are my thoughts for reference.

src: 第十七条 国家对注册消防工程师资格实行注册执业管理制度。

chosen.text: Article 17 The state shall implement a registration and practice management system for registered fire engineers.

src: 取得一级、二级注册消防工程师资格证书的人员，经注册方可以相应级别注册消防工程师名义执业。

chosen.text: Those who have obtained the first and second level registered fire engineer qualification certificates may practice in the name of registered fire engineers at the corresponding level after registration.

src: 第十八条 公安部消防局是一级注册消防工程师资格的注册审批部门。

chosen.text: Article 18 The Fire Protection Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security is the registration and approval department for first-level registered fire engineers.

src: 省、自治区、直辖市公安机关消防机构为二级注册消防工程师资格的注册审批部门，并负责一级注册消防工程师资格注册的初步审查工作。

chosen.text: The fire protection agencies of the public security organs in provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the Central Government are the registration approval departments for the qualification of Level II registered fire engineers, and are responsible for the preliminary examination of the registration of Level I registered fire engineers.

src: 第十九条 取得一级、二级注册消防工程师资格证书并申请注册的人员，应当受聘于一个经批准的消防技术服务机构或者消防安全重点单位，并通过聘用单位向本单位所在地(聘用单位属企业的，通过本企业向工商注册所在地)的公安机关消防机构提交注册申请材料。

chosen.text: Article 19 Persons who have obtained the qualification certificates of first-class and second-class registered fire engineers and apply for registration shall be employed by an approved fire technical service institution or a key fire safety unit, and submit the registration application materials to the fire protection agency of the public security organ at the location of the unit (if the employing unit is an enterprise, submit it to the industrial and commercial registration location through the enterprise).

src: 第二十条 省、自治区、直辖市公安机关消防机构在收到申请人的注册申请材料后，对申请材料不齐全或者不符合法定形式的，应当当场或者在5个工作日内，一次 性告知申请人需要补正的全部内容，逾期不告知的，自收到申请材料之日起即为受理。

chosen.text: Article 20 After receiving the registration application materials of the applicant, the fire protection agency of the public security organ of the province, autonomous region or municipality directly under the Central Government shall, if the application materials are incomplete or do not conform to the legal form, inform the applicant of all the content that needs to be corrected on the spot or within five working days. If it fails to inform the applicant after the expiration of the time limit, the application shall be accepted from the date of receipt of the application materials.

src: 对受理或者不予受理的注册申请，均应当出具加盖本级公安机关消防机构专用印章和注明日期的书面凭证。

chosen.text: For registration applications accepted or not accepted, a written certificate with the special seal of the fire department of the public security organ at the corresponding level and the date shall be issued.

src: 第二十一条 省、自治区、直辖市公安机关消防机构自受理注册申请之日起20个工作日内，按规定条件和程序完成一级注册消防工程师资格注册申请材料的初步审查工作和二级注册消防工程师资格的注册审批工作，并将一级注册消防工程师资格注册申请材料和初步审查意见报公安部消防局审批。

chosen.text: Article 21 The fire protection agencies of the public security organs of provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the Central Government shall complete the preliminary examination of the registration application materials for first-class registered fire engineers and the registration approval of the qualifications of second-class registered fire engineers within 20 working days from the date of acceptance of the registration application, and submit the registration application materials for first-class registered fire engineers and the preliminary examination opinions to the Fire Protection Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security for approval.

src: 公安部消防局应当自收到省级公安机关消防机构报送的申请材料和初步审查意见之日起，20个工作日内作出是否批准的决定。

chosen.text: The Fire Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security shall make a decision on whether to approve within 20 working days from the date of receiving the application materials and preliminary review opinions submitted by the fire institutions of provincial public security organs.

src: 在规定的期限内不能作出批准决定的，应当将延长的期限和理由告知申请人。

chosen.text: If the approval decision cannot be made within the prescribed time limit, the applicant shall be informed of the extended period and reasons.

src: 对作出不予批准决定的，应当书面说明理由，并告知申请人享有依法申请行政复议或者提起行政诉讼的权利。

chosen.text: If a decision is made not to approve, the reasons shall be stated in writing and the applicant shall be informed of his/her right to apply for administrative reconsideration or initiate an administrative lawsuit according to law.

src: 第二十二条 注册审批部门应当自作出批准决定之日起10个工作日内，颁发、送达相应级别的注册证。

chosen.text: Article 22 The registration and approval department shall issue and deliver the corresponding level of registration certificate within 10 working days from the date of making the approval decision.

src: 第二十三条 注册证的每一注册有效期为3年。

chosen.text: Article 23: The validity period of each registration of the registration certificate is 3 years.

src: 注册证在有效期内是相应级别注册消防工程师的执业凭证，由注册消防工程师本人保管、使用。

chosen.text: The registration certificate is the practice certificate of the registered fire engineer at the corresponding level during the validity period, and shall be kept and used by the registered fire engineer himself/herself.

src: 第二十四条 申请初始注册的，应当自取得一级、二级注册消防工程师资格证书之日起1年内提出申请。

chosen.text: Article 24: For initial registration, an application shall be filed within one year from the date of obtaining the qualification certificate for first-level and second-level registered fire engineers.

src: 逾期申请初始注册时，须符合本规定继续教育要求。

chosen.text: When applying for initial registration after the deadline, the continuing education requirements of these regulations must be met.

src: 初始注册、延续注册、变更注册、注销注册和不予注册等注册管理的具体办法，由公安部另行规定。

chosen.text: Specific measures for registration management, such as initial registration, renewal registration, change registration, cancellation registration and non-registration shall be separately stipulated by the Ministry of Public Security.

src: 第二十五条 继续教育是注册消防工程师延续注册、重新注册和逾期初始注册的必备条件。

chosen.text: Article 25 Continuing education is a prerequisite for the renewal of registration, re-registration and overdue initial registration of registered fire engineers.

src: 在每个注册有效期内，各级别注册消防工程师应当按照规定完成相应的继续教育。

chosen.text: During each registration validity period, registered fire engineers of all levels should complete corresponding continuing education as required.

src: 第二十六条 注册审批部门应当及时向社会公告注册消防工程师注册有关情况，建立注册消防工程师诚信档案，对其执业活动实行信用管理。

chosen.text: Article 26 The registration and approval department shall promptly announce to the public the relevant information of the registered fire engineers, establish a credit file for registered fire engineers, and implement credit management for their practice activities.

src: 第二十七条 各级注册消防工程师资格的注册管理部门，应当严格执行《中华人民共和国行政许可法》有关规定。

chosen.text: Article 27 The registration management departments of registered fire engineers at all levels shall strictly implement the relevant provisions of the Administrative License Law of the People's Republic of China.

src: 中越两军“和平救援-2021”卫勤联合演习圆满结束-新华网

chosen.text: The Sino-Vietnam Joint Military Medical Exercise "Peace Rescue-2021" has successfully concluded - Xinhuanet

src: 新华社河内12月12日电（周娜 滕怀金）12日上午，参加中越两军“和平救援-2021”卫勤联合演习的中方参演分队全部安全返回中国广西境内，标志着此次持续7天的演训任务顺利完成。

chosen.text: Xinhua News Agency, Ha Noi, December 12 (Zhou Na, Teng Huaijin) - On the morning of December 12, all the Chinese participating units in the "Peace Rescue-2021" joint medical exercise between China and Vietnam returned safely to Guangxi, China, marking the successful completion of the seven-day exercise mission.

src: 此次联演，中越两军围绕人道主义医学救援这一重大课题，紧扣卫勤救死扶伤使命任务，按照实战化标准完成了联合卫勤指挥、联合现场救援、批量伤员处置等课目内容，有效提升了两军卫勤保障能力。

chosen.text: During this joint exercise, the two armies of China and Vietnam focused on the major topic of humanitarian medical rescue, closely followed the mission of medical aid and first aid, and completed the contents of joint medical command, joint on-site rescue, and mass casualty disposal according to the actual combat standards, effectively enhancing the medical support capabilities of the two armies.

src: 演习成果得到中越两军的肯定。

chosen.text: The results of the exercise were affirmed by both the Chinese and Vietnamese armies.

src: 越方演习指导委员会主任、越南人民军后勤总局副主任兼参谋长阮雄胜在演习结束仪式上说，通过此次演习，越南军医从中国军医身上学到了演习组织及专业活动方面的知识，也见识了中方的医疗、保障设备。

chosen.text: Ruan Xiongsheng, Director of the Steering Committee for the Vietnamese military exercise, Deputy Director and Chief of Staff of the General Logistics Department of the Vietnamese People's Army, said at the ceremony that ended the exercise that through this exercise, the Vietnamese military doctors learned knowledge about the organization of the exercise and professional activities from the Chinese military doctors, and also saw the medical and support equipment of China.

src: 演习取得的成果证明了两国军医力量在医疗援助、疫情防控方面的专业能力。

chosen.text: The results of the exercise proved the professional capabilities of the military medical forces of both countries in terms of medical aid and epidemic prevention and control.

src: 中方指导协调组组长、中央军委后勤保障部卫生局副局长陈春明表示，此次演习是在2018年成功举办联合义诊活动的基础上又一次开拓创新实践，具有非常重要的里程碑意义。

chosen.text: Chen Chunming, head of the Chinese Steering and Coordination Group and deputy director of the Health Bureau of the Logistics Support Department of the Central Military Commission, said that this exercise is another pioneering and innovative practice based on the successful joint free clinic in 2018, which has very important milestone significance.

src: 演习期间，中国人民解放军向越南人民军捐赠了医用防护口罩、医用防护服、快速核酸检测仪器等卫生防疫物资。

chosen.text: During the exercise, the People's Liberation Army of China donated medical protective masks, medical protective clothing, rapid nucleic acid testing instruments and other health and epidemic prevention materials to the Vietnamese People's Army.
